title.rendered: How to Check If Your iPhone Is Unlocked

content.rendered:
Many people never realize their iPhone has a carrier lock because everything works fine on their current network. The problem shows up later when they try to switch carriers, activate an eSIM, use a local SIM while traveling, or hand the phone to someone else. Since carrier locks are not always obvious, it is smart to confirm the unlock status ahead of time to avoid activation errors, unexpected limitations, and issues when reselling the device.

If you are not sure how to check whether your iPhone is unlocked or carrier-locked, this guide walks you through the process step by step. You will also learn the difference between locked and unlocked iPhones, so you know what to expect.

  • Before You Switch Carriers

Locked vs Unlocked iPhone: What It Means

Carrier locking is a network restriction applied by a mobile provider. It controls which SIMs or eSIMs the iPhone can use.

What Is a Locked iPhone?

A locked iPhone is restricted to a single carrier at the network level. The lock is added by the carrier and enforced during activation using Apple’s activation servers.

What Is an Unlocked iPhone?

An unlocked iPhone works with any supported carrier. You can insert any compatible SIM or set up any eSIM without restrictions.

How to Check if Your iPhone Is Unlocked

If you want to check whether your iPhone is unlocked, follow the steps below. These methods work on most models and iOS versions.

1. Check Carrier Lock in Settings

This is the fastest way for anyone running iOS 14 or newer.

  1. Go to Settings → General → About.
  2. Here, scroll down to Carrier Lock and check the status next to it.
  3. If it says “No SIM restrictions,” your iPhone is unlocked.
  4. If you see a specific carrier name or a SIM-locked message, it means the device is locked.

2. Test With a SIM From Another Carrier

While the “No SIM restrictions” status in iPhone settings is the quickest way to confirm whether your iPhone is unlocked, you can test it with another SIM card for hands-on confirmation. Moreover, this is the only manual way to check the unlocked status on iPhones running on older iOS versions.

Simply turn off your iPhone, remove the SIM tray, swap the SIM card, reinsert the tray, and turn the iPhone back on.

If the iPhone connects to the network and shows signal bars, it is unlocked. But if you see a “SIM not supported” or “invalid SIM” message, the iPhone is locked.

3. Verify With Your Carrier Using IMEI

If the iPhone claims to be unlocked in Settings but you still cannot use another carrier, it may be an activation or provisioning issue.

In such cases, contact your carrier and ask them to verify the unlock status using your iPhone’s IMEI number.

To find the IMEI on your iPhone, go to Settings → General → About, and scroll down to find the IMEI number.

If the issue persists even after the carrier confirms the unlock status, contact Apple Support to determine whether the problem lies with your iPhone.

4. Check Apple Purchase Records

iPhones bought directly from Apple are usually unlocked unless stated otherwise. This is helpful for second-hand or gifted devices.

Try the following:

  • Search your purchase invoice or Apple Store receipt.
  • If you no longer have them, contact Apple Support and provide the serial number.

They can confirm if the device was originally sold locked or unlocked.

Why It Matters to Confirm Unlock Status

An unlocked iPhone does not gain new software features, but it offers real-world benefits:

  • Freedom to switch networks at any time.
  • Cheaper travel with local SIMs or eSIMs abroad.
  • Higher resale and trade-in value.
  • No disputes when buying or selling used devices.

If you plan to upgrade, trade in, sell your iPhone, or move to a better data plan, knowing the unlock status removes guesswork.

What to Do If Your iPhone Is Locked

If the device turns out to be locked, the only legitimate and safe method is to request an official unlock.

Steps to follow:

  1. Contact the original carrier.
  2. Complete any pending payments or eligibility requirements.
  3. Wait for confirmation.
  4. Restart the iPhone. In some cases, a backup and restore helps apply the change.

Avoid third-party unlocking tools and shady services. These can be illegal or leave your device blocked from activation.

Before You Switch Carriers

Now you know how to check if an iPhone is unlocked using Settings, SIM testing, carrier verification, or Apple purchase details. Making sure the device is fully unlocked avoids activation errors that usually show up during an eSIM setup or when using a new physical SIM.

If you have recently switched networks or purchased a used iPhone, check the unlock status before making changes.

FAQs

Can I unlock my iPhone myself?

Only the carrier or Apple can officially remove a carrier lock. Resetting the device does not unlock it.

How long does it take to unlock an iPhone?

Most carriers complete unlocking within a few hours to a few days after eligibility is confirmed.

Is an unlocked iPhone more valuable?

Unlocked iPhones usually have higher resale value and are easier to sell or trade in.

@graph.name: How to check if your iPhone is unlocked in Settings
@graph.description: Quickly confirm whether your iPhone is unlocked right from Settings, so you know if it will work with SIM cards from other carriers.

supply.name: iPhone with an active or past SIM profile

step.name: Open Settings
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone to access device information.

itemListElement.text: Unlock your iPhone.
Tap the Settings app on your Home Screen.

step.name: Go to About
step.text: Navigate to General, then tap About to view your iPhone’s details.

itemListElement.text: Tap General in the Settings list.
Tap About at the top of the screen.

step.name: Find Network Provider Lock
step.text: Scroll down to the Network Provider Lock section to see the lock status.

itemListElement.text: Swipe up to reveal additional fields.
Locate the Network Provider Lock entry.

step.name: Interpret the status
step.text: If it shows No SIM restrictions, your iPhone is unlocked. Any other status indicates it is locked and you should contact your carrier to request an unlock.

itemListElement.text: Read the value next to Network Provider Lock.
Contact your carrier if the status indicates a lock.

@graph.name: How to know if your iPhone is unlocked with a SIM card
@graph.description: Check if your iPhone is unlocked by swapping SIM cards and testing connectivity, so you can confirm whether it works with other carriers.

supply.name: Second SIM card from another carrier

step.name: Test your current SIM card
step.text: Make a phone call using your current SIM card to confirm that it connects.

itemListElement.text: Dial a contact or number from your iPhone.
Ensure the call goes through successfully.

step.name: Turn off your iPhone
step.text: Hold the Sleep/Wake button, then push the on-screen slider to power off your iPhone.

itemListElement.text: Press and hold the Sleep/Wake button.
Drag the Power Off slider to shut down the device.

step.name: Swap SIM cards
step.text: Eject your SIM card using a SIM card ejector tool, then insert a SIM card from another carrier.

itemListElement.text: Insert the SIM ejector tool into the SIM tray hole to remove the current SIM.
Take out the old SIM card and replace it with the second SIM card.

step.name: Turn on your iPhone
step.text: Press the Sleep/Wake button to turn your iPhone back on with the new SIM card.

itemListElement.text: Hold down the Sleep/Wake button until you see the Apple logo.
Wait for your iPhone to finish restarting.

step.name: Test with the new SIM card
step.text: Make a phone call using the new SIM card. If the call connects, your iPhone is unlocked. If it does not, your iPhone is locked to your original carrier.

itemListElement.text: Dial a number using the second SIM card.
Confirm if the call goes through successfully.

@graph.name: How to check if iPhone is unlocked using IMEI
@graph.description: Use your iPhone’s IMEI number with an online checker to confirm whether your device is carrier unlocked.

tool.name: Web browser on a computer or phone

step.name: Find your IMEI number
step.text: Open Settings, tap General, then tap About to view your device details and note the IMEI.

itemListElement.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
Tap General, then tap About.
Scroll to IMEI and copy the number.

step.name: Open the IMEI checker
step.text: Go to the IMEI24 website in your browser to use the free checker.

itemListElement.text: Launch Safari or your preferred browser.
Navigate to the IMEI24 website.

step.name: Enter your IMEI
step.text: Paste or type the IMEI into the checker field, then click Check.

itemListElement.text: Click the IMEI input box on the page.
Enter the IMEI and select Check.

step.name: Complete the captcha
step.text: Solve the captcha challenge to verify you are not a robot and proceed to the results.

itemListElement.text: Tick the I am not a robot box or follow the prompts.
Submit the captcha to continue.

step.name: Check the lock status
step.text: Review the information card and look for Lock Status. If it says unlocked, your iPhone works with other carriers.

itemListElement.text: Read the results card carefully.
Confirm the Lock Status shows unlocked or contact your carrier if it shows locked.

keyPoints.title: Meaning of 'Unlocked' iPhones
keyPoints.explanation: An unlocked iPhone can connect to any carrier, making switching providers or traveling abroad seamless, whereas a locked iPhone is restricted to a specific carrier.

keyPoints.title: Checking if your iPhone is unlocked in Settings
keyPoints.explanation: Go to Settings > General > About, and look for 'Network Provider Lock'; if it says 'No SIM restrictions,' your iPhone is unlocked.

keyPoints.title: Using SIM Cards to Test Unlock Status
keyPoints.explanation: Insert a different carrier's SIM card and try making a call; if successful, the iPhone is unlocked, otherwise it's locked to the original carrier.

keyPoints.title: Checking IMEI for Unlock Status Online
keyPoints.explanation: Find your IMEI in Settings > General > About, then use a free online tool like IMEI24 to check if your iPhone is unlocked by entering the IMEI number.

keyPoints.title: Confirming with Your Carrier
keyPoints.explanation: Contact your cell provider with your IMEI or phone details; they can verify if your iPhone is unlocked and provide assistance if needed.

title.rendered: Apple Gets Temporary Relief From China Chip Tariffs Until 2027

content.rendered:
Apple recently gained a breather from potential cost hikes associated with U.S. tariffs on Chinese semiconductors, thanks to a delay in their immediate impact.

A Federal Register filing, covered by CNBC, indicates that while the U.S. plans to move forward with tariffs on semiconductor imports from China, the actual tariff rate will remain at zero percent for approximately 18 months. These tariffs are now set to take effect on June 23, 2027, with the final percentage being announced at least a month prior.

What This Means for Apple

This move temporarily lifts the pressure of increased import costs on various semiconductor components that are crucial to Apple’s extensive product lineup.

While Apple crafts its own A-series and M-series chips, these are produced by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company in Taiwan, sidelining them from the China-specific tariff. However, Apple still relies significantly on Chinese suppliers for other vital chips—such as power management ICs, display driver chips, connectivity controllers, and other logic components found within iPhones, iPads, Macs, and accompanying accessories.

Most of these parts are likely to be affected by the China-targeted semiconductor tariff when it eventually rises in 2027. This delay is significant for Apple’s cost management and supplier agreements.

A Delay, Not a Rollback

Although the tariff is technically initiated immediately, the zero percent rate functions more as a delay than an outright suspension. This maintains the legal groundwork for potential tariff hikes later on, sidestepping immediate trade interference.

For companies like Apple, this provides temporary certainty while leaving long-term questions unresolved.

Strategic Timing for Apple

The timing of this reprieve aligns well with Apple’s ongoing efforts to diversify production beyond China. Back in August, Apple vowed to invest $600 billion in U.S. domestic manufacturing and infrastructure, thereby buying more time to adapt its supply chain before any tariff costs potentially hit in 2027.

Would this matter to you? Share your thoughts below.

excerpt.rendered: Apple gets temporary relief from U.S. tariffs on Chinese chips, with rates held at zero until June 2027. This delay eases short-term cost pressure while Apple adapts its supply chain.

title.rendered: Apple AirPods Could Finally Move Beyond Their Signature White

content.rendered:
Apple’s AirPods have long been identified by their signature white hue. However, it seems that this iconic design might not have been as set in stone as once thought. Freshly surfaced photos of early prototypes hint that Apple initially flirted with the idea of adding some vibrancy to its popular wireless earbuds.

Old Prototypes Hint at a More Colorful Idea

A well-respected Apple leaker recently shared images showing alluring pink and yellow AirPods units, believed to stem from Apple’s internal testing phase before the earbuds hit the market in 2016. What’s remarkable about these prototypes is their apparent readiness. Far from being rough early concepts, they bear the look of near-completion, suggesting that Apple seriously considered colorful versions, not just as a fleeting notion.

Why Apple Stuck With White in the End

Ultimately, Apple decided to introduce the original AirPods in their now-familiar white. This choice likely aligned with the company’s strategy at the time to keep the design simple and universally recognizable. The white color not only complemented Apple’s existing audio accessories but also solidified AirPods’ place within the broader product lineup. Even so, the discovery of these colorful prototypes reveals that Apple once pondered alternative designs before committing to the present aesthetic.

Could Colorful AirPods Make a Comeback?

While these newly revealed images don’t confirm imminent changes, they do spark intriguing speculation. Apple has become more adventurous with color in recent years, extending vibrant options to products like the iPhone and MacBook. The fact that colorful AirPods were once on the table suggests that such variations aren’t entirely off the cards for the future. As it stands, Apple has made no official announcements regarding new color options for AirPods. Nevertheless, these early prototypes remind us that even the most recognizable designs might have untold stories and unexplored paths lurking behind them.

Would a splash of color in your AirPods catch your attention? Share your thoughts below.

title.rendered: WhatsApp Web May Soon Let Users Manage Call Notifications

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is reportedly gearing up to add a new feature allowing users to manage voice and video call notifications directly through WhatsApp Web. According to a report from WABetaInfo, the latest beta version of WhatsApp Web introduces a toggle specifically for controlling these notifications within the settings panel.

With WhatsApp moving towards supporting calls via its web client, this adjustment suggests a wider expansion of notification management options on WhatsApp Web.

Call Alerts Expected to Be Enabled by Default

When this functionality becomes available to everyone, call notifications are anticipated to be switched on by default. Much like the mobile and desktop versions of WhatsApp, incoming calls will prompt browser notifications, even if the chat window isn’t open. This helps users notice calls while engaged in other tabs or applications.

Moreover, users are free to toggle call notifications on or off, depending on personal preferences. This is particularly useful for those who prefer handling calls on their phone or simply use the web version for messaging during office hours.

It’s important to clarify that disabling call notifications on the web client doesn’t equate to blocking calls outright. It merely stops browser alerts from showing up.

Web and Mobile Notification Settings Will Remain Separate

The settings for call notifications on WhatsApp Web will remain entirely independent from those on mobile devices. Changes made on the web won’t affect how notifications behave on iPhone or Android, and vice versa.

End-to-End Encryption Remains Intact

This new feature is being developed with user privacy at the forefront. Therefore, all voice and video communications on WhatsApp Web will maintain their end-to-end encryption. By utilizing the Signal Protocol, WhatsApp ensures that only the participants of a call have access to its content.

Even when originating from a web browser, neither WhatsApp nor any third-party entities will have the ability to eavesdrop or access the encrypted data.

Voice and Video Calling Support Still in Development

Efforts continue on WhatsApp’s part to bring voice and video call capabilities to its web platform. However, there’s still no official word on when both features will see a full release.

Once these updates go public, users will be able to make and receive calls directly from their browser, bridging more of the functional gap between WhatsApp Web and its mobile counterparts.

Would you find voice and video calls on WhatsApp Web useful? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title.rendered: How to Remove the Background From a Picture on iPhone

content.rendered:
Not long ago, removing the background from a photo meant using desktop software or downloading complicated third-party apps. With recent iOS updates, that is no longer necessary. Your iPhone can now remove backgrounds from pictures and even erase unwanted objects using built-in tools, all in just a few taps.

These features make background removal quick, accurate, and easy for everyday users. And if you need cleaner edges, transparent images, or more professional results, there are still apps that can help you take things further. This post details how to remove the background from photos on an iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • Why Remove the Background from an Image?
  • Remove Background from Picture on iPhone Using Built-in Tools
    • Using the Photos App
    • Using the Files App Quick Action Menu
    • Using a Siri Shortcut
    • Using the Apple Pages App
  • Third-Party Apps to Remove Backgrounds from Images
  • Tips for Achieving the Best Results
  • Background Removal Made Simple…

Why Remove the Background from an Image?

When you want to use an image in a specific way rather than keep it as a full scene, the background often adds little value and can even get in the way. In such cases, removing the background makes sense because it lets you:

  • Isolate a person or object so it stands out clearly.
  • Create profile pictures with a clean and distraction-free look.
  • Prepare product images for listings, catalogs, or promotions.
  • Reuse the same subject across multiple designs or platforms.
  • Place images neatly into documents, slides, or presentations.
  • Maintain a consistent visual style across posts and projects.

Remove Background from Picture on iPhone Using Built-in Tools

Apple offers multiple built-in options that let you remove photo backgrounds directly on your iPhone, without installing third-party apps. These tools can automatically detect and isolate subjects, making it easy to copy, share, or reuse images across apps.

Using the Photos App

Starting with iOS 16, Apple lets you lift the main subject from a photo or video frame, separate it from the background, and then copy or share it across other apps and documents. All of this can be done directly within the Photos app, without requiring a third-party app. Here’s how you can:

  1. Open the image in the Photos app.
  2. Tap and hold the subject until a glowing outline appears around it.
  3. Now, tap the Share button in the contextual menu.
  4. Next, tap the Save Image button on the share sheet.

In addition to isolating subjects from their background, Apple also offers tools like Clean Up in the Photos app for removing specific unwanted objects, which can be useful when you do not need to remove the entire background.

Using the Files App Quick Action Menu

While the Photos app does the job well, the Files app offers a less obvious but more practical background-removal tool. The Files app includes a dedicated “Remove Background” tool that typically produces a transparent PNG, making it suitable for product images and documents, and for reuse across platforms.

  1. Save the original image to the Files app.
  2. Tap and hold the image until a pop-up menu appears.
  3. Now, tap Quick Actions, then Remove Background.
  4. Once done, the Files app will automatically separate the subject from the image and save it as a separate image in the same folder.
Note You can also remove backgrounds from multiple images at once using the Files app.

Using a Siri Shortcut

You’re missing out on a lot if you still don’t use Apple’s Shortcuts app. For example, you can use it to automate image background removal. With the correct shortcut, the app can combine image input with the system’s subject-isolation feature and save the results directly to the Photos app.

To do so, first add the “Remove Background from Photo” shortcut to the Shortcuts app on your iPhone.

Once done, you can simply activate Siri and ask “Remove Background from Photo,” select the image you want to process, and the shortcut will automatically remove the background and save the resulting image to the Photos app.

Using the Apple Pages App

If you want more control than the Photos and Files app offers without installing third-party tools, Apple Pages includes a simple built-in background-removal tool. It lets you remove backgrounds directly from an image and manually refine the selection if the automatic result is not perfect.

  1. Open the Pages app and tap the Start Writing button.
  2. Tap the + button, then select Photo or Video on the subsequent menu.
  3. Select the image you want to process.
  4. Now, tap the Paintbrush icon → Image.
  5. Tap Remove Background.
  6. If you are satisfied with the result, tap Done.
  7. Otherwise, you can refine the selection manually by touching and dragging the part of the image you want to make transparent.
  8. Once done, tap the image once, then tap Copy in the contextual menu.
  9. You can now paste the background-removed image in the Files app, use it in other apps, or place it in documents or designs.

Third-Party Apps to Remove Backgrounds from Images

While your iPhone’s built-in tools can remove backgrounds quickly, they often struggle with complex details such as shadows, hair, or busy backgrounds. In such cases, third-party image-editing apps and services deliver more accurate results and greater control over the final output.

Popular options include:

  • Adobe Express: For quick AI-powered background removal with the ability to instantly replace or customize the background.
  • remove.bg: For fast and accurate automatic background removal, especially for portraits and product images.
  • Canva: For users who want background removal combined with ready-made templates and drag-and-drop design tools.
  • Adobe Photoshop: For advanced users who need precise control over edges, hair, and transparency.

Tips for Achieving the Best Results

Keep these practical points in mind to get cleaner and more accurate background removal results:

  • Use photos with clear subject separation, where the subject stands out from the background
  • Avoid busy or cluttered backgrounds when possible, as they make edge detection harder
  • Good lighting improves accuracy, especially around hair and fine details
  • Use built-in tools for quick edits and switch to third-party apps for complex images
  • Always review edges and refine them if the tool allows manual adjustments.
  • Export images as PNG when you need a transparent background.

Background Removal Made Simple…

Apple has turned background removal into an everyday feature rather than a specialist skill. For most images, the built-in tools are fast, private, and good enough. When quality matters more than speed, third-party apps and professional editors fill the gap.

Knowing which tool to use and when is what makes the difference between a quick cutout and a polished final image.

Have you tried removing photo backgrounds on your iPhone yet? Share which method works best for you in the comments.

FAQs

Can I restore the original image after removing the background?

iPhone background removal tools do not overwrite the original photo. Therefore, your original image remains unchanged, and background-removed versions are created as separate copies.

Is there a cost involved with third-party apps?

Many third-party apps offer free background removal with basic features. However, advanced options such as high-resolution exports, batch processing, or refined edge controls often require a subscription or one-time purchase.

Does removing the background affect image quality?

Background removal does not reduce image quality by itself, but the final result depends on the tool used. Built-in tools may struggle with fine details, while professional apps usually preserve sharper edges and better transparency.

acceptedAnswer.text: Only the carrier or Apple can officially remove a carrier lock. Resetting the device does not unlock it.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most carriers complete unlocking within a few hours to a few days after eligibility is confirmed.

mainEntity.name: Can I restore the original image after removing the background?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone background removal tools do not overwrite the original photo. Therefore, your original image remains unchanged, and background-removed versions are created as separate copies.

mainEntity.name: Is there a cost involved with third-party apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many third-party apps offer free background removal with basic features. However, advanced options such as high-resolution exports, batch processing, or refined edge controls often require a subscription or one-time purchase.

mainEntity.name: Does removing the background affect image quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Background removal does not reduce image quality by itself, but the final result depends on the tool used. Built-in tools may struggle with fine details, while professional apps usually preserve sharper edges and better transparency.

title.rendered: How to Remove iPhone Calendar Viruses and Prevent Them in the Future

content.rendered:
Your iPhone Calendar app is meant to simplify your schedule, not bombard you with fake virus alerts, scam reminders, or too-good-to-be-true prize notifications. Unfortunately, cyber attackers have figured out how to abuse Apple’s calendar invitation system to push unwanted events straight onto your device once permission is accidentally granted through a misleading website or pop-up.

If your calendar is suddenly packed with alerts you never knowingly subscribed to, you are not alone. These so-called iPhone calendar viruses are a common scam tactic, and they can feel especially invasive because they bypass the traditional app-install process.

This post explains what iPhone calendar viruses are, how they get onto your device, and how to remove them permanently.

Table of Contents
  • What Is an iPhone Calendar Virus?
  • How These Calendar Viruses Spread
  • How to Remove a Calendar Virus from an iPhone
    • 1. Remove Suspicious Subscribed Calendars via Settings
    • 2. Unsubscribe Using the Calendar App
    • 3. Delete Remaining Spam Events
    • 4. Delete Individual Spam Events If Needed
    • 5. Offload and Reinstall the Calendar App If Needed
  • What to Do If Spam Still Appears?
  • Preventing Future Calendar Viruses
  • Be Cautious with Permissions
    • Enjoy a Spam-Free Calendar…

What Is an iPhone Calendar Virus?

First things first, an iPhone calendar virus is not malware you need to be careful about. It’s simply an unwanted, accidental calendar subscription that sends spam events and notifications.

Since calendar subscriptions do not require an app installation, they bypass the App Store and show alerts directly through iOS notifications.

Related: How to Remove a Virus or Malware from iPhone or iPad

How These Calendar Viruses Spread

In most cases, this happens when you tap a deceptive link on a website, in a message, or in an email. Without making it obvious, the page prompts you to approve a calendar subscription either by claiming your iPhone is infected and asking you to confirm, or by showing a fake prize or CAPTCHA page that asks you to subscribe, which then adds a stream of spam events directly to your Calendar app.

As the calendar syncs via iCloud, the same spam can appear on all Apple devices associated with the same Apple ID.

How to Remove a Calendar Virus from an iPhone

Once you know the cause, cleaning up your Calendar spam is straightforward. Follow these steps to remove spam calendar events.

1. Remove Suspicious Subscribed Calendars via Settings

Since calendar spam almost always originates from an active subscription rather than individual events, checking for and removing such subscriptions is the most effective way to remove a calendar virus on iPhone. Here’s how you can:

  1. Open Settings, scroll down and tap on Apps.
  2. Locate and tap the Calendar app.
  3. Tap Calendar Accounts.
  4. Tap Subscribed Calendars.
  5. Select the Subscribed Calendar you don’t recognize.
  6. Tap Delete Account.

2. Unsubscribe Using the Calendar App

If you prefer to work directly in the Calendar app, you can remove subscriptions there as well.

  1. Open the Calendar app and tap the Calendar icon at the bottom.
  2. Here, tap the i button next to the suspicious calendar under Subscribed.
  3. Tap Unsubscribe.
  4. Tap Unsubscribe or Unsubscribe and Report Junk to confirm.

3. Delete Remaining Spam Events

You might still receive spam calendar alerts even after removing the related subscription. This is because sometimes previously synced spam events linger briefly after unsubscribing. Removing them ensures a clean calendar view.

  1. Open the Calendar app.
  2. Tap Delete Event.

4. Delete Individual Spam Events If Needed

In rare cases, spam events are added individually rather than through a subscription. These must be removed one by one.

So, if needed, open each suspicious event in the Calendar app and delete it individually until no spam remains.

5. Offload and Reinstall the Calendar App If Needed

If the Calendar app continues to behave oddly, even after you’ve cleaned up everything, offloading and reinstalling the app might help, as it clears the app’s cache. Here’s how:

  1. Go to Settings → General → iPhone Storage.
  2. Locate and tap the Calendar app.
    Tap the spam event.
  3. Tap the Offload App button.
  4. Next, restart your iPhone.
  5. Now, simply tap the Calendar app icon on the home screen to reinstall it.
    You can also report a spam event by tapping Report Junk, then Delete and Report Junk.

Rest assured, your calendar data remains intact.

What to Do If Spam Still Appears?

If the spam alerts continue even after doing everything we’ve suggested so far, there is likely another active calendar source. In such cases, you must:

  • Recheck Subscribed Calendars.
  • Review all calendar accounts, such as iCloud, Gmail, or Outlook.
  • Temporarily disable Calendar notifications while troubleshooting.

This is because persistent spam almost always traces back to an active subscription.

Preventing Future Calendar Viruses

Knowing how to remove calendar viruses will not help if you keep accidentally subscribing to spam calendars. These simple habits reduce the risk of accidentally subscribing to spam calendars in the future and help keep your iPhone calendar clean:

  • Never tap Allow Subscribe or OK on virus warnings.
  • Avoid websites that use aggressive scare tactics.
  • Close pages that claim your iPhone is infected.
  • Do not interact with prize or giveaway pop-ups.
  • Keep iOS updated for security improvements.

Be Cautious with Permissions

Calendar permissions are powerful because they allow silent syncing and notifications. Always read permission prompts carefully and decline anything that feels urgent or unclear.

Enjoy a Spam-Free Calendar…

And that’s it. You now know that calendar spam is not malware and does not compromise your data, and the fastest way to remove it is to delete the unwanted calendar subscription. Once the subscription expires, spam stops immediately and does not return.

Have you dealt with calendar spam on your iPhone? Share which step worked for you in the comments to help other readers avoid the same issue.

FAQs

What causes calendar viruses on iPhones?

Calendar viruses are caused by accidentally approving spam calendar subscriptions through deceptive websites or links.

Can calendar viruses steal my data?

No. Calendar spam cannot access personal data, install apps, or control your device.

Are virus removal apps safe?

They’re not needed for calendar spam and won’t offer any extra protection. Built-in iPhone security already handles this issue.

blockGraphs.question: Can calendar viruses steal my data?

title.rendered: Tim Cook Makes a Bold Move on Nike Stock During a Tough Week

content.rendered:
Apple’s CEO, Tim Cook, has recently taken a significant financial step by purchasing close to $3 million in Nike stock. This decision came at a crucial moment, just days after Nike experienced a notable fall in share prices due to lackluster earnings reports.

Cook’s investment quickly garnered market interest, particularly against the backdrop of Nike’s challenges with decelerating growth and skeptical investors.

A $3 Million Investment That Captured Attention

On December 22, Tim Cook acquired 50,000 Class B shares of Nike at an average rate of $58.97 per share. This move boosted his total holdings in the company to approximately 105,000 shares, now valued at nearly $6 million.

The timing of this investment is particularly noteworthy, considering Nike’s stock took a hit after failing to meet earnings expectations. This constitutes Cook’s most substantial open market purchase of Nike shares in many years.

Nike Shares’ Immediate Response

Following the revelation of Cook’s purchase, Nike stock began to bounce back. Shares saw an increase of between 2% and 5% in early trading, partially recovering from earlier losses in the week.

This recovery came after a sharp decline of roughly 10% immediately after Nike’s quarterly results were announced, a cumulative loss of about 13% over a few days.

The Importance of Tim Cook’s Role at Nike

Cook isn’t just any investor in Nike; he has been on the company’s board since 2005 and became the lead independent director in 2016. He also chairs Nike’s compensation committee, which places him deeply involved in the company’s governance and strategic planning.

Given his extensive involvement, many investors interpret his stock purchase as more than a simple financial maneuver, seeing it as a mark of confidence in Nike amid its current pressures.

An Expressive Signal of Faith in Nike’s Path

Market analysts view Cook’s investment as a robust endorsement of Nike’s leadership, particularly CEO Elliott Hill, who made a comeback to the company post-retirement. Observers have highlighted this as the largest open market stock acquisition by a Nike director or executive in over a decade.

Tim Cook’s choice to make such a rare move sends a clear message. This time, that message appears to be a belief in Nike’s future direction.

Does this move signal confidence to you? Share what you think.

excerpt.rendered: Apple CEO Tim Cook made a rare $3 million open-market purchase of Nike shares shortly after the stock plunged on weak earnings, a move many investors see as a strong vote of confidence in the company’s future.

title.rendered: 10 Best Roblox Anime Games to Play Right Now

content.rendered:
The best anime games on Roblox all share one thing: growth. You start weak, confused, and limited. and slowly earn power through time, skill, and understanding. In 2025, Roblox is flooded with anime-inspired games, but most burn out fast. They either lack depth, stop updating, or give players nothing meaningful to work toward.

This list cuts through that noise. These Roblox anime games respect your time, reward commitment, and are enjoyable to play for hours. for months. later.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Blox Fruits
  • 2. Jujutsu Infinite
  • 3. Shindo Life
  • 4. Attack on Titan Revolution
  • 5. Blue Lock Rivals
  • 6. Anime Battle Arena
  • 7. King Legacy
  • 8. All Star Tower Defense X
  • 9. Demon Slayer RPG 2 / Project Slayers
  • 10. Arcane Odyssey
  • Final Thoughts

1. Blox Fruits

Inspired by One Piece, Blox Fruits has earned its popularity through consistency and scale.

Players choose between becoming a Pirate or a Marine and explore a massive ocean filled with islands, enemies, and powerful bosses. The progression system is easy to understand but difficult to rush. You level up, unlock new abilities, and search for Devil Fruits that completely change how you fight and move.

What truly keeps Blox Fruits alive is its steady update cycle. New islands, weapons, fruits, and level caps expand the world without invalidating past progress. There is always another goal just out of reach, and that constant sense of forward momentum is why players keep returning.

Looking for more freebies? Check out the latest Blox Fruits codes to grab in-game rewards.

Play Blox Fruits

2. Jujutsu Infinite

Jujutsu Infinite understands that power should feel earned, not handed out.

Based on Jujutsu Kaisen, the game focuses on cursed techniques that grow stronger the more you actively use them. Progression happens through combat, missions, bosses, and daily activities rather than menu grinding, which makes advancement feel natural and engaging.

Combat feels intense but controlled. Positioning, cooldown management, and timing matter far more than button mashing. With story content and repeatable challenges always available, the game consistently gives players clear direction and purpose. If you want a similar experience with steady progression rewards, checking out Jujutsu Infinite codes can scratch that same itch by letting you claim boosts and resources as you play.

Play Jujutsu Infinite

3. Shindo Life

Shindo Life succeeds because it refuses to rush the player.

Inspired by Naruto, this RPG emphasizes customization above all else. Bloodlines, elements, mentors, and abilities combine to create deeply unique builds. Two players at the same level can play and fight in completely different ways.

The learning curve is steep, but once the systems click, the depth becomes addictive. Frequent updates expand existing mechanics rather than replacing them, allowing long-term players to grow without losing progress or familiarity. If you’re jumping between titles, keeping up with Shindo Life codes can give you that same feeling of steady progression from day one.

Play Shindo Life

4. Attack on Titan Revolution

Attack on Titan Revolution captures the intensity of Attack on Titan by making movement the core of combat.

Using omni-directional mobility gear is not just a feature—it is the combat system. Speed, angles, and timing decide whether you land a perfect strike or get crushed instantly. Mastering movement feels genuinely rewarding and skill-based.

Titan transformations add a second layer of strategy, while clans and cooperative missions encourage teamwork and replayability. Every encounter feels fast, physical, and dangerous.

Play Attack on Titan Revolution

5. Blue Lock Rivals

Blue Lock Rivals strips football down to pressure, positioning, and ego.

Based on Blue Lock, the game features short, intense matches where you control a single character. Every playstyle has clear strengths and weaknesses, and goals come from smart decision-making rather than luck or chaos.

Regular balance updates and new styles keep the competitive meta fresh. Wins feel earned, and losses feel like lessons instead of frustrations. If you want a little boost while you grind, check out the latest codes for Blue Lock Rivals to grab some freebies and build your dream squad faster.

Play Blue Lock Rivals

6. Anime Battle Arena

Anime Battle Arena is a pure test of skill. Characters from multiple anime series face off in fast-paced battles where every ability serves a purpose. Smaller movesets mean success depends on timing, spacing, and matchup knowledge—not overwhelming your opponent with effects.

Matches are quick, clean, and highly replayable. Whether played casually or competitively, the game rewards mastery and respects player skill.

Play Anime Battle Arena

7. King Legacy

King Legacy delivers a more approachable and forgiving take on the One Piece formula while still offering long-term depth.

Progression is structured around quests, exploration, and combat, with Devil Fruits playing a central role in how players fight and move. Unlike harsher grind-focused games, King Legacy smooths out the early and mid-game experience, allowing players to grow steadily without feeling stuck or underpowered.

One of the game’s biggest strengths is its flexibility. Stat resets are accessible, which encourages experimentation with different builds and Devil Fruits without punishing curiosity. This makes the game especially welcoming for newer players while still offering enough systems and challenges to keep veterans engaged.

Play King Legacy

8. All Star Tower Defense X

All Star Tower Defense X focuses on strategy, planning, and long-term investment rather than quick wins.

The game brings together characters from multiple anime series and places them into a classic tower defense structure. Early stages are designed to teach mechanics clearly, including unit placement, upgrades, and timing. As difficulty increases, success depends on understanding unit synergies, positioning, and coordination with teammates.

While gacha mechanics are present, the game consistently provides free summons, currency, and event rewards. You can stack even more by redeeming the latest Star Tower Defense X codes when they drop.

Play All Star Tower Defense X

9. Demon Slayer RPG 2 / Project Slayers

Both Demon Slayer RPG 2 and Project Slayers capture the precision and discipline that define Demon Slayer combat.

Breathing styles are more than cosmetic choices. They directly influence movement, attack patterns, and combat flow. Each style requires learning timing, spacing, and proper execution, making fights feel deliberate instead of chaotic.

Exploration plays a large role, with expansive maps, structured quests, and powerful boss encounters that test both skill and preparation. Progression is clear and goal-oriented, guiding players forward without overwhelming them with unnecessary systems.

Play Demon Slayer RPG 2 | Play Project Slayers

10. Arcane Odyssey

Arcane Odyssey stands out by delivering an anime-like experience without relying on an existing anime franchise.

This original RPG places heavy emphasis on exploration, experimentation, and player choice. Magic types, weapons, and combat styles evolve based on how players approach the game rather than locking them into rigid paths. Your build develops naturally through use, discovery, and adaptation.

The world itself is demanding. Travel, combat, and progression require attention and learning, rewarding players who take their time to understand systems instead of rushing through content. Every improvement feels earned, whether it comes from mastering a spell, refining a build, or overcoming a difficult encounter.

Play Arcane Odyssey

Final Thoughts

The best anime Roblox games aren’t about flashy effects or instant power. They’re about progress, commitment, and the satisfaction of getting better over time.

Every game on this list earns its place by giving players something real to work toward. and a reason to stay.

title.rendered: WhatsApp Tests AI Image Editing for Status Updates on iOS

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is currently testing some new AI-enhanced image editing tools specifically for status updates on iOS devices. As reported by WABetainfo, a select group of beta testers is gaining access to a revamped image editing interface when they go to prepare photo-based status updates.

The update brings in Meta AI-powered Imagine tools alongside the existing filters, allowing users to perform more sophisticated edits without having to exit the app.

New AI Styles for Photo Editing

A notable addition is a set of AI-generated visual styles that offer different artistic treatments of photos. Users can choose from styles like 3D, Comic Book, Anime, Classical, Clay, Felt, Kawaii, Painterly, and Video game-themed looks. These styles go beyond static filters by generating AI-based variations of the original images.

To refine the look, each style can be regenerated multiple times with a Redo option, which creates different AI interpretations without requiring the editing process to restart. This feature lets users tweak the final image to better align with their intended mood or artistic vision.

Content-Aware Editing and Object Removal

Beyond styles, this editor enables users to insert new elements, remove unwanted objects, and make other localized adjustments. If objects are removed, the AI automatically fills in the backgrounds to maintain a natural appearance. There’s also an option to use short text prompts to transform the scene or adjust the image’s overall mood.

Image Animation Adds Motion to Status Update

Another interesting addition is the ability to animate images, turning static photos into brief animated visuals intended to create more engaging status updates. These animations add a touch of motion while keeping the original context of the photos intact.

Also Read: WhatsApp Is Testing a New Peripheral Section in Linked Devices on iOS

Availability

Currently, these AI-enhanced tools are available to a limited number of users who have the latest WhatsApp beta version for iOS. Some users with the stable version from the App Store might also see the feature pop up. The rollout is happening gradually across select regions as WhatsApp collects user feedback before a broader release.

Would the introduction of AI-powered editing tools in WhatsApp status updates be significant to you? Share your thoughts with us below.

excerpt.rendered: WhatsApp is testing an AI image editor for Status on iOS that lets you enhance photos, add styles, and generate visual changes before posting. Early trials hint at a smarter, more creative Status experience coming soon.

acceptedAnswer.text: Many third-party apps offer free background removal with basic features. However, advanced options such as high-resolution exports, batch processing, or refined edge controls often require a subscription or one-time purchase.

title.rendered: iPhone Air 2 Might Still Arrive Next Year

content.rendered:
Rumors surrounding Apple’s next iPhone Air 2 seem less certain today, as a fresh report suggests the device may hit the market sooner than previously anticipated. According to the latest information, Apple’s release could still align with a fall 2026 debut, sticking closer to the company’s earlier schedule.

This insight comes from a notable leaker Fixed Focus Digital. Reports indicate that those familiar with Apple’s internal discussions believe the next iteration of the iPhone Air remains on track for a fall debut. If this proves true, the device could join Apple’s typical annual iPhone lineup, as opposed to being postponed to a later date.

Conflicting Reports Create Uncertainty

This new information challenges earlier claims that pointed to a delay of the iPhone Air 2 until March 2027. Initially, these reports speculated a joint unveiling with the standard iPhone 18 and a budget-friendly iPhone 18e variant.

Apple was initially expected to showcase the second iPhone Air in fall 2026 alongside premium models like the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and possibly a foldable iPhone. However, tepid sales of the original iPhone Air reportedly led Apple to reconsider its approach, potentially pushing back the release date.

Given the mixed reports, Apple’s final decision remains a mystery. While postponement still seems plausible based on multiple earlier leaks, the fall 2026 release window can’t be completely dismissed.

Apple Is Said to Be Fixing Key Complaints

Focus on enhancements seems to be a major theme for the new iPhone Air. Addressing user feedback from the first model, Apple is rumored to be adding a second rear camera. This change aims to rectify criticisms regarding the original’s specs.

Pricing is another area of focus. It appears Apple is strategizing to make the iPhone Air 2 more wallet-friendly, aiming for broader market appeal. Other upgrades reportedly include reductions in weight, improved heat management using vapor chamber cooling, and a bigger battery for longer life.

If Apple’s team has indeed intensified work on these improvements, it could shed light on persistent speculation about a 2026 launch.

A Launch Window Still in Question

While Apple’s sticking to the initially planned 2026 release remains a possibility, it would be unexpected given the prevalent predictions of a delay. As it stands, the timing for the iPhone Air’s next chapter lies amidst conflicting reports, leaving the launch date as the looming question.

Until Apple’s official word comes out, it’s best to stay cautiously optimistic. Whether the iPhone Air 2 sees the light of day next year or later, it’s evident Apple aims to refine the product to better meet user desires in a sleek, premium handset.

Do these developments influence your interest in an iPhone Air 2? Share your thoughts below.

excerpt.rendered: New leaks suggest Apple could still release the iPhone Air 2 in fall 2026. Conflicting reports point to feature upgrades, pricing changes, and uncertainty around Apple’s final launch plans.

acceptedAnswer.text: Only the carrier or Apple can officially remove a carrier lock. Resetting the device does not unlock it.

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone background removal tools do not overwrite the original photo. Therefore, your original image remains unchanged, and background-removed versions are created as separate copies.

mainEntity.name: Is there a cost involved with third-party apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many third-party apps offer free background removal with basic features. However, advanced options such as high-resolution exports, batch processing, or refined edge controls often require a subscription or one-time purchase.

mainEntity.name: Does removing the background affect image quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Background removal does not reduce image quality by itself, but the final result depends on the tool used. Built-in tools may struggle with fine details, while professional apps usually preserve sharper edges and better transparency.

title.rendered: Best iPhone Apps for Your 2026 New Year’s Resolutions

content.rendered:
As the New Year approaches, many of us set fresh goals and commit to new habits. Turning those intentions into daily action takes planning, consistency, and accountability. Fortunately, a wide range of iPhone apps can help you define meaningful goals, track progress, stay motivated, and build better routines throughout the year. Whether you want to improve wellness, boost productivity, learn new skills, or manage your finances, the right digital tools can make sticking to your resolutions far easier.

Below, we highlight some of the best resolution-supporting apps for iOS users in 2026.

Table of Contents
  • What Makes the Best New Year's Resolution App?
  • 7 Best New Year's Resolutions Apps for iPhone
    • 1. MyFitnessPal: Calorie Counter – For Fitness and Health Goals
    • 2. Way of Life – Habit Tracker – For Building Better Habits
    • 3. YNAB (You Need a Budget) – For Financial Resolutions
    • 4. Calm – For Mental Health and Mindfulness
    • 5. Todoist: To Do List & Calendar – For Productivity and Time Management
    • 6. Duolingo – Language Lessons – For Learning New Languages
    • 7. Goodreads: Book Reviews – For Tracking Books and Discovering Reads
  • Turn Resolutions Into Daily Progress…

What Makes the Best New Year’s Resolution App?

Before discussing the apps this article recommends, let’s examine some of the features that make them the best New Year’s resolution apps.

  • Ease of Use/User-Friendly Interface: One key feature to look for in a New Year’s resolutions app is its ease of use and user-friendly design. The last thing you want is an app with a cluttered interface that complicates staying organized, learning a new language, or achieving your goals. That’s why ease of use has been a top consideration in the apps recommended on this list.
  • Customization: Another essential feature of a great New Year’s resolution app is the ability to customize. The app should allow you to tailor its features to your specific needs with various customization options. For instance, a to-do app should let you group your tasks to keep your list more organized.
  • Goal Tracking: These apps should include goal-tracking features to help you monitor whether you’re meeting your daily goals. This provides insight into your performance and progress toward your resolutions.
  • Reminders and Notifications: These are essential for keeping you committed to your New Year goals and resolutions. Apps with this feature help ensure you stay on track with timely nudges.
  • Affordability or Free Options: Not everyone has a budget for app subscriptions, so an ideal app should offer free options with basic features that get the job done or provide an affordable subscription plan.
  • Cross-Platform Syncing: This feature ensures seamless access to your data across devices. For instance, you can log data or create a to-do on your web browser and later access it through the iOS app.

As part of our testing approach, we’ve reviewed several New Year’s resolution apps and selected the most effective based on the factors listed above. Let’s jump into them.

7 Best New Year’s Resolutions Apps for iPhone

Here is the round-up of our best apps to make and keep your New Year’s resolutions.

1. MyFitnessPal: Calorie Counter – For Fitness and Health Goals

MyFitnessPal tops our list of the best New Year resolution apps. It is perfect for anyone focused on food tracking and weight management, whether you aim to lose weight, maintain it, gain weight, build muscle, or manage stress. The app also lets you tailor its features, such as setting the amount of weight you aim to gain to match your specific goals.

It helps you stay consistent with reminders and makes food logging easy through its extensive meal database, detailing calories and micronutrients for each item. Paid users can speed up the process by scanning barcodes or food items. Plus, it adjusts your daily calorie needs based on the exercises you log, helping you track your weight management journey more intentionally.

Although MyFitnessPal includes workout logging, it’s not as well-featured as dedicated fitness apps like Strong, making it less ideal for gym enthusiasts focused on detailed tracking.

The free version does include ads that can be intrusive, but it still provides essential features like basic food logging and calorie tracking. If you’re on a budget, it’s a reliable choice to kick off your New Year’s fitness goals. The app requires iOS 16.0 or later to run and sync data effectively across devices.

Pros

  • Efficient calorie and micronutrient tracking
  • Step tracking
  • Intermittent fasting tracker
  • Customizable user interface
  • Syncs seamlessly across devices
  • Includes a basic workout guide

Cons

  • Intrusive ads in the free version
  • Limited workout tracking features

Pricing: Offers a limited free version, with full access available through a $9.99 monthly premium plan.

Download

2. Way of Life – Habit Tracker – For Building Better Habits

Building a habit is one of those things we often struggle with, but if that’s one of your New Year’s resolutions, the Way of Life habit tracker could be exactly what you need. Whether you’re looking to build habits of no alcohol or soda, save money, pray, wake up early, study, or something else, this app helps you stay on track by allowing you to check them off daily until they become habits.

You can choose from a variety of suggested habits or create your own custom ones if what you want isn’t already included. The free version lets you log up to three items, but for more, you’ll need to upgrade to the premium plan.

The app also lets you set reminders for your chosen habits to ensure you’re notified throughout the day until they become routine. One of the standout features of this app is its simplicity and uncluttered user interface. It also lets you view trends for your habits in chart format, giving you a clear visual overview of your progress or a shareable snapshot of your journey.

We also note that the app lets you add notes to your habit journal if you have something specific to point out—whether it’s a different approach on a particular day. Please note that the app requires iOS 15.6 or later.

Pros

  • Easy to use
  • Reminders to notify you of your habits
  • Note-taking feature
  • Ability to export journals

Cons

  • Limited habit options for free users
  • No collaboration feature

Pricing: Offers a free limited version, with premium access starting at $4.99 per month.

Download

3. YNAB (You Need a Budget) – For Financial Resolutions

If you’re having trouble keeping your spending under control, YNAB is the app to check out. It helps you create a budget tailored to your spending habits. When you launch the app, it asks a few simple questions about how you spend and then organizes your budget into categories like bills, needs, and wants. However, you can also create a custom budget category.

You can set targets for each category and either link your bank accounts to automatically capture your balances or manually enter your balances to assign funds to your budget items.

One of the standout features is YNAB Together, which lets you share your subscription with up to five people without sharing your password. Everyone can create and share their own account to manage budgets, making it ideal for partners or family members.

The app is designed to help you build better spending habits. If that sounds like what you need, you can try it free for 35 days before starting a subscription. Please ensure you’re on iOS 16.0 or later to use it.

Pros

  • Simplifies creating a personal budget
  • Helps build intentional spending habits
  • User-friendly interface

Cons

  • The iOS app interface is more cluttered compared to the web version
  • The sync feature is not always reliable

Pricing: Offers a 35-day free trial, after which the subscription costs $14.99 per month.

Download

4. Calm – For Mental Health and Mindfulness

The next New Year’s resolution app we recommend is Calm, a renowned tool for personalized recommendations to improve your mental health. Whether you aim to boost happiness, reduce anxiety, enhance performance, improve sleep, or build self-esteem, this app could be the perfect fit.

Calm offers effective features like Breath Bubble exercises and relaxing soundscapes to help you unwind after a stressful day or when you struggle to fall asleep. True to its name, the app is designed to help you achieve a calm state and support overall well-being.

Additional features include a mood check-in, which allows you to log your feelings each day and receive tailored recommendations based on your mood. You can also create playlists with your favorite sounds and download them for offline use.

Plus, Calm supports multiple languages, making it accessible for non-English speakers. The app requires iOS 16 or later.

Pros

  • Great for mindfulness and meditation
  • Provides a relaxing way to unwind
  • Offers several soothing sounds
  • Includes stats and streak features
  • Mindfulness reminder

Cons

  • Limited access to sounds and features in the free version
  • Lacks sleep tracking features

Pricing: Offers a very limited free version, with premium access starting at $14.99 monthly.

Download

5. Todoist: To Do List & Calendar – For Productivity and Time Management

Keeping track of your to-dos with just your memory isn’t easy, you’ll probably forget some and end up feeling burnt out. That’s where Todoist comes in: it helps you log your tasks and check them off as you complete them.

It’s an easy-to-use app that allows you to set due dates, reminders, and priority levels for your tasks. You can break tasks into sub-tasks to ensure everything is well-organized with labels and reminders. Pro users can take it a step further with location-based reminders—just add a location to a task, and you’ll be notified when you arrive.

Todoist is an efficient way to stay on top of tasks and boost productivity for your team. In the “My Projects” section, you can collaborate by inviting others to your tasks, assigning tasks, and setting due dates—similar to project management apps like ClickUp.

It also lets you add comments and upload files to tasks when needed. If you want to free your mind, better organize your to-dos, and start the new year on a productive note, Todoist is a solid choice. The free version gets the job done for us, but if you’re looking for more features, you can upgrade to the Pro version. The app requires iOS 15.0 or later.

Pros

  • Great for keeping organized to-dos
  • Reminders to keep you notified of your tasks
  • Collaboration features
  • Real-time syncing

Cons

  • Some features are hidden behind a paywall

Pricing: Offers a limited free version, with premium access starting at $4.99 monthly.

Download

6. Duolingo – Language Lessons – For Learning New Languages

Duolingo is the go-to app for anyone starting a New Year’s resolution to learn a new language. Its engaging, game-like approach keeps learning fun, offering XP and badges for completing exercises. You can learn a wide range of languages, including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Chinese, Portuguese, Dutch, Greek, Hindi, and even basic math.

The app allows you to set flexible learning routines, whether it’s 10 or 20 minutes a day, and sends reminders to help you build a consistent learning habit. After choosing your desired language, you can select your fluency level if you’re already familiar with it or start from scratch as a beginner.

Duolingo’s method is thorough, covering the basics of speaking and understanding the language. It’s widely recognized as one of the most effective apps for language learning, with a strong track record of success.

Pros

  • Provides a fun and interactive way to learn new languages
  • Provides daily reminders
  • It can be used on the go

Cons

  • Not ideal for advanced language learners
  • Does not provide recognized language certification

Pricing: Offers a limited free version, with premium access starting at $9.99 monthly.

Download

7. Goodreads: Book Reviews – For Tracking Books and Discovering Reads

Many people set a simple New Year’s resolution to read more, but struggle to stay engaged without structure. Goodreads supports this goal without acting like a habit tracker or planner. You can set a yearly reading challenge, discover new books, track what you are currently reading, and see recommendations based on your interests.

The social aspect also helps. Seeing what friends are reading and sharing reviews adds light accountability without reminders or streak pressure. It works well for users who want a low-effort, interest-driven resolution that still feels meaningful.

Best for readers who want to read more consistently in the New Year without productivity tools.

Pros

  • Easy way to set and track a yearly reading goal
  • Massive book database with ratings and reviews
  • Social features help discover books through friends 

Cons

  • Interface feels outdated
  • Recommendations are not always accurate
  • No built-in ebook or audiobook support

Pricing: Offers a completely free experience with no subscription or premium plan required.

Download

Turn Resolutions Into Daily Progress…

Sticking to New Year’s resolutions takes more than motivation. The right apps can remove friction, simplify daily actions, and help you stay aligned with your goals as the year progresses. Instead of trying to do everything at once, choose tools that match your priorities and fit naturally into your routine. Small, consistent steps supported by the right apps often make the biggest difference over time.

mainEntity.name: Can I unlock my iPhone myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only the carrier or Apple can officially remove a carrier lock. Resetting the device does not unlock it.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to unlock an iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most carriers complete unlocking within a few hours to a few days after eligibility is confirmed.

mainEntity.name: Is an unlocked iPhone more valuable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlocked iPhones usually have higher resale value and are easier to sell or trade in.

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone background removal tools do not overwrite the original photo. Therefore, your original image remains unchanged, and background-removed versions are created as separate copies.

mainEntity.name: Is there a cost involved with third-party apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many third-party apps offer free background removal with basic features. However, advanced options such as high-resolution exports, batch processing, or refined edge controls often require a subscription or one-time purchase.

mainEntity.name: Does removing the background affect image quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Background removal does not reduce image quality by itself, but the final result depends on the tool used. Built-in tools may struggle with fine details, while professional apps usually preserve sharper edges and better transparency.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: How to Use Text Effects and Formatting in iMessage on iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Being an avid iMessage user, I love how Apple’s Messages app has moved far beyond plain text. First came bubble and screen effects, followed by text formatting and text effects, all of which let me add emphasis to messages without turning conversations into sticker-heavy chaos.

Unlike bubble or screen effects that animate an entire message, text effects and formatting work at a more precise level. You can highlight a word, style a short phrase, or animate an emoji inside the message bubble itself. The result feels intentional and conversational rather than loud or gimmicky.

If you have seen bold text, styled words, or animated phrases in an iMessage thread and were not sure how they were created, read on to learn everything you need to know about text formatting and text effects on iPhone and iPad.

What Are Text Formatting and Message Effects in iMessage?

Besides bubble and screen effects, Apple offers two distinct ways to enhance text in Messages. Although they are often grouped together, they serve very different purposes.

Text formatting changes how your text looks. It is static, focused on readability, and lets you apply bold, italic, underline, or strikethrough. This makes it ideal for adding emphasis in longer messages, instructions, or more serious conversations.

Text effects add animation to selected text or emojis inside the message bubble. Options such as Big, Small, Shake, Nod, Explode, Ripple, Bloom, and Jitter draw attention to specific words. These effects work best for short reactions, emotional emphasis, or playful moments rather than full paragraphs.

Text Formatting vs Message Effects: What’s the Difference?

Requirements to Use iMessage Text Formatting and Effects

  • Both text formatting and text effects require iOS 18 and iPadOS or later installed on your iPhone and iPad.
  • Works only in iMessage conversations.
  • Both the sender and the recipient must be on compatible software for the effects to appear correctly.

How to Send Text Messages With Effects or Formatting on iPhone and iPad

Once you know what text formatting and text effects do, the actual process of using them is straightforward. Both options are built directly into the text field in the Messages app and work on selected text before you send the message. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Messages app and head to an existing iMessage conversation or create a new one.
  2. Here, type your message as you normally do, but do not hit the Send button.
  3. Now, select the part of the message you want to animate.
  4. Tap Text Effects in the contextual menu that appears. You can tap and hold a word or double-tap to highlight it, then adjust the selection handles to include more text or an emoji.
  5. You will now see a list of available animations along with the text formatting options.
  6. Tap an effect or formatting option to preview it directly on your selected text.
  7. Once satisfied with the selected animation or formatting, tap the Send button next to the message field.
  8. Alternatively, you can use text formatting and text effects together by applying formatting to one part of the message and a text effect to another part before sending it.
Note When using an external keyboard on iPad or iPhone, standard formatting shortcuts such as Command plus B or I may be available depending on the app context. Animated text effects still require on-screen selection and menu access.

How to Combine Text Formatting With Bubble and Screen Effects

Text effects, bubble effects, and screen effects can work together. You can apply a text effect to specific words first, then long-press the Send button to choose a bubble or screen effect. The animation plays on the selected text inside the message bubble, while the bubble or screen effect surrounds the entire message.

Text formatting works alongside text effects as well, although moderation matters. A bold word with a subtle animation can feel expressive and deliberate. Too many effects layered together quickly feel noisy rather than thoughtful.

Best Practices for Using iMessage Text Effects

Message effects are most effective when they feel deliberate rather than decorative. Used thoughtfully, they help guide attention and tone without distracting from the conversation. Here are the best practices to follow:

  • Use effects intentionally to match the conversation’s tone.
  • Avoid applying multiple animations in a single message.
  • Prefer text formatting for longer or serious messages.
  • Use text effects mainly for short reactions or emphasis.
  • Preview the message before sending to check readability.
  • When unsure, choose subtle formatting over animation.

iMessage Text Effects Not Working? How to Fix It

Express More With iMessage Text Effects and Formatting

Text effects in Messages are one of those underrated features that feel unnecessary until you start using them thoughtfully. When applied with restraint, they add clarity, tone, and personality without distracting from the conversation.

If you rely on iMessage for everyday conversations, text effects give you greater control over how your messages are read and perceived.

FAQs

Can I use text effects when messaging Android users?

Text effects only work with iMessage. Messages sent to Android phones appear as plain text.

Do text effects work on Mac?

Yes, the Messages app on macOS supports text effects on compatible macOS versions, though the interface differs slightly.

Can I animate emojis using text effects?

Yes, emojis can be selected and animated just like text, which often appears subtler than large emoji reactions.

  • How to Use Emoji as Tapback Reactions in Messages

@graph.name: How to Add a Text Effect in the Messages App
@graph.description: Learn how to easily add fun and expressive text effects in the Messages app on your iPhone or iPad to enhance your conversations.

step.name: Open the Messages app
step.text: Launch the Messages app on your iPhone or iPad.

itemListElement.text: Open the Messages app from your home screen.

step.name: Select a conversation
step.text: Go to the chat where you want to send a message with an effect.

itemListElement.text: Tap on the conversation with the person you want to message.

step.name: Type your message
step.text: Enter your message in the text field at the bottom.

itemListElement.text: Type the message you want to send.

step.name: Highlight the message
step.text: Select all or part of the text that you want to apply the effect to.

itemListElement.text: Tap and hold the message, then drag to highlight the desired portion.

step.name: Tap the Text Effects icon
step.text: Tap the icon to view available text effects.

itemListElement.text: Look for the Text Effects icon above the keyboard and tap it.

step.name: Choose and send the effect
step.text: Select your preferred effect and tap the send icon to deliver the message.

itemListElement.text: Scroll through the effect options, tap the one you like, then hit the send arrow.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.
