title.rendered: Best Wireless Charging Mouse Pads You Should Buy Now

content.rendered:
Wireless charging mouse pads are one of the coolest upgrades you can add to your desk. They combine a comfortable mouse mat with a built-in wireless charger, letting you power your iPhone, Android, earbuds, or other Qi-compatible devices while you work or play. These smart pads help reduce clutter, boost productivity, and make your desk look neater and tech-savvy.  

In this guide, we break down five of the best wireless charging mouse pads currently available, focusing on usability, design, charging performance, and value. 

Table of Contents
  • Who Should Get a Wireless Charging Mouse Pad?
  • 5 Best Wireless Charging Desk Mats
    • 1. GIM Wireless Charging RGB Gaming Mouse Pad – Best for Gamers
    • 2. Miroddi Magnetic Wireless Charging Desk Mat: Charge iPhone and AirPods Together
    • 3. TopMade Wireless Charging Mouse Pad: Durable & Heat-Resistant
    • 4. abc.mat Store Wireless Charging Desk Mat: Beautiful Pink Look
    • 5. HAUTOCO 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Mouse Pad: Affordable Utility
  • Wireless Charging Mouse Pad Buying Tips
    • Final Takeaway

Who Should Get a Wireless Charging Mouse Pad? 

A wireless charging desk mat is ideal for someone looking to have a clean, efficient, and modern desktop. Here’s who will like it the most: 

  • Desk workers and remote professionals: Keep your phone charging while you work, without extra cables. 
  • People with small or cluttered desks: Accommodate your keyboard, mouse, and other accessories with a charger into one space-saving mat. 
  • Gamers & creators: Enjoy RGB lighting and stay powered during long sessions without plugging in devices. 
  • Cable-free setup lovers: Reduce desk clutter and enjoy a cleaner workspace. It also protects your desk from scratches and wear. 

5 Best Wireless Charging Desk Mats

These charging desk mats keep your workspace clean while powering your phone, earbuds, and accessories in one place.

 1. GIM Wireless Charging RGB Gaming Mouse Pad – Best for Gamers

The GIM Wireless Charging Desk Mat is an excellent all-around choice. Its XL size (about 800×300 mm) and 15W fast-charging support are ideal for users who want both a large surface area and a powerful charger. 

I liked its beautiful artwork with 10 LED modes, adding a cool aesthetic touch to my setup without being too over the top. Moreover, the non-slip base keeps the pad firmly in place even during intense mouse movement. 

Best For: Gamers and multitaskers who want a stylish, functional desk mat at a good price. 

2. Miroddi Magnetic Wireless Charging Desk Mat: Charge iPhone and AirPods Together 

The Miroddi pad keeps things simple and functional. You get 15W Qi-compatible wireless charging for your Apple devices with a strong magnetic hold. The pad includes 11 RGB modes with various patterns and memory functions. 

If you have a laptop, the pad’s XXL size accommodates it and its accessories. The best part is the textured micro-weave cloth surface that’s waterproof, wear-resistant, and provides superior tracking accuracy. Plus, the one-year warranty gives peace of mind.  

Best For: Office workers or casual users who want a tough, robust desk mat with dependable charging. 

3. TopMade Wireless Charging Mouse Pad: Durable & Heat-Resistant 

If durability is your top priority, the TopMade pad focuses on long-lasting build quality and everyday usability. Its smooth-textured top surface is waterproof, easy to clean, and heat-resistant. Moreover, you can glide your mouse on it effortlessly. 

This pad also has two wireless charging areas for your phone and AirPods, supporting up to 15W magnetic wireless charging. You can see the charging status and over-temperature indication on the top light.  

Best For: People who want a smooth desk mat for both office work and light gaming. 

4. abc.mat Store Wireless Charging Desk Mat: Beautiful Pink Look 

The abc.mat Store pad gives an aesthetic upgrade to your desk. The large size has room for your keyboard, mouse, and other accessories. Additionally, the built-in magnets auto-align your phone and AirPods, and protection against overcurrent and overheating ensures secure, precise charging.  

However, it only supports a 7.5W power supply. So, if you want fast charging, you may skip this. The faux leather, high-density micro-woven fabric surface, and anti-slip rubber base make this mouse pad durable for daily use.  

Best for: Users seeking a beautiful desk mat with solid wireless charging capability. 

5. HAUTOCO 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Mouse Pad: Affordable Utility 

The HAUTOCO pad is designed to be practical and budget-friendly. It packs three magnetic wireless charging stations for your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch. The best part is that you can charge your phone in a portrait or landscape position with the raised charging coil. 

Additionally, there are 15 RGB lighting modes to suit your mood. The fabric surface will allow spills and normal wear. Hence, this desk mat offers all the necessary features at an affordable price. 

Best For: Budget-minded shoppers who want powerful wireless charging and RGB lighting with their desk mat. 

Wireless Charging Mouse Pad Buying Tips 

Here are some points you should consider before making the purchase: 

  • Charging Power: Consider pads that are compatible with Qi technology and 15W power delivery. This would be sufficient for most mobile phones and other devices.  
  • Surface Feel: A smooth, low-drag surface helps your mouse move accurately. Cloth or micro-textured pads are usually comfortable and versatile.  
  • Size: Extended pads (keyboard + mouse) are great for workstations, while smaller ones are ideal for compact desks.  
  • Extras Matter: RGB lighting, water resistance, and non-slip bases are important for day-to-day use. These, however, must align with your workflow and not disrupt it. 

Final Takeaway 

If you spend hours at your desk and rely on your phone throughout the day, a wireless charging desk mat is a small investment with everyday benefits. Choose one that matches your desk size, charging needs, and usage style, and enjoy a smarter, more organized workspace.  

Whether you’re building a home office, upgrading a gaming setup, or simply want a cleaner desk, our list has the right wireless charging desk mat to make a noticeable difference in daily comfort and convenience.  

Have you used a mouse pad like this before? Let us know in the comments below!

acceptedAnswer.text: A clean, minimal feed benefits from filters that make subtle adjustments rather than visible changes. Filters that gently lift brightness, control contrast, and avoid strong color casts usually work best.

mainEntity.name: How to find trending effects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trending effects often appear repeatedly in popular Reels. Tapping the effect name shown above a Reel lets you preview and save it. The Effects gallery in the Stories camera also highlights trending options, although these rotate frequently.

mainEntity.name: Can too many effects hurt engagement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Overusing effects can distract viewers and make content feel cluttered or inconsistent. Effects are most effective when they support the story or mood rather than compete with it.

mainEntity.name: Are filters and effects free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s built-in filters and most AR effects are free. While some third-party apps sell presets or editing tools, Instagram itself does not charge for filters or effects.

title.rendered: Stanford’s Popular iOS Development Course Is Now Free for Spring 2025

content.rendered:
Those keen on mastering iOS development without the hefty price tag of a bootcamp have often turned to Stanford’s CS193p, a well-loved option on the web. It is now even easier to dive into.

Stanford University has refreshed its CS193p course, officially titled Developing Applications for iOS using SwiftUI, for Spring 2025. The updated release includes all 16 lecture videos available for free, along with comprehensive supporting materials.

What’s Available in This Update

Since 2020, Stanford has shared CS193p openly, moving away from iTunes U to more accessible platforms like YouTube and the university’s own course website. The full Spring 2025 series is now live, giving learners access to every one of the 16 lectures through the course website and a dedicated YouTube playlist.

What You Won’t See: IOS 26 And Xcode 26 Features

Before getting started, it is important to know that these lectures were recorded before the release of Apple’s iOS 26 and Xcode 26. Stanford notes that while the code used in the course is largely compatible, it does not reflect the latest platform changes.

As a result, the course does not include coverage of newer additions such as Xcode 26’s built-in LLM assistance or the Liquid Glass interface design introduced in iOS 26.

Why The Course Still Holds Value

Despite this limitation, CS193p continues to be highly recommended by experienced developers. As a Stanford-taught course, it focuses on building strong foundations in iOS development and presents the material in a clear, approachable way.

For beginners or developers looking to solidify their understanding of SwiftUI, the Spring 2025 release remains a structured, reliable, and completely free place to start.

mainEntity.name: Can I restore the original image after removing the background?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone background removal tools do not overwrite the original photo. Therefore, your original image remains unchanged, and background-removed versions are created as separate copies.

mainEntity.name: Is there a cost involved with third-party apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many third-party apps offer free background removal with basic features. However, advanced options such as high-resolution exports, batch processing, or refined edge controls often require a subscription or one-time purchase.

acceptedAnswer.text: Calendar viruses are caused by accidentally approving spam calendar subscriptions through deceptive websites or links.

mainEntity.name: Can calendar viruses steal my data?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Calendar spam cannot access personal data, install apps, or control your device.

mainEntity.name: Are virus removal apps safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: They’re not needed for calendar spam and won’t offer any extra protection. Built-in iPhone security already handles this issue.

acceptedAnswer.text: Trending effects often appear repeatedly in popular Reels. Tapping the effect name shown above a Reel lets you preview and save it. The Effects gallery in the Stories camera also highlights trending options, although these rotate frequently.

title.rendered: How to Download Your Instagram Data: Messages, Photos and Activity

content.rendered:
If you’ve been using Instagram for years, the platform knows far more about your activity than you might realize. Beyond the photos and Reels you post publicly, Instagram quietly stores private messages, search history, interaction patterns, account settings, and detailed activity logs tied to your profile. Over time, this information builds into a complete digital record of how you use the app.

So, if you are curious about what Instagram stores about your account or want a personal backup of your content, downloading your Instagram data is the only way to access it. Read on to find out how to download your Instagram data and what you’ll get.

Table of Contents
  • Why Download Your Instagram Data
  • What Does Instagram Data Download Include
  • How to Download Your Instagram Data
    • On the Mobile App
    • On the Web
  • Accessing and managing your downloaded Instagram data
  • Taking Control of Your Instagram Data…

Why Download Your Instagram Data

Downloading your Instagram data allows you to view the platform beyond the feed. It gives you access to the full record of your account, including content you posted years ago, private conversations, searches, and behind-the-scenes activity that is not visible in the app.

It also serves as a reliable backup. Accounts can be restricted, compromised, or removed without warning, and once that happens, recovering years of photos, videos, and messages becomes difficult or impossible.

For privacy-conscious users, the download offers clarity. It shows exactly what information Instagram retains about you, helping you better understand and manage your digital footprint.

Finally, if you plan to archive your content or move away from Instagram, downloading your data ensures you retain full control rather than leaving it locked within the platform.

What Does Instagram Data Download Include

When you request a copy of your Instagram data, the social media platform prepares an archive of all the information associated with your account. This includes:

  • All uploaded content, such as photos, videos, Stories, and Reels, along with captions and timestamps
  • Direct messages, comments, likes, saved posts, and account information, like profile details and settings
  • Followers and following data, including close friends, blocked accounts, pending follow requests, recent follow requests, recently unfollowed profiles, and removal suggestions.

Beyond visible content, the download also includes:

  • Your activity data, such as your search history, login information, device details, and interaction logs.
  • Metadata like location tags, upload dates, and engagement records.

Some advertising-related insights and inferred interests may be limited or summarized rather than fully detailed.

How to Download Your Instagram Data

The steps to download your Instagram Data are almost identical on both the mobile app and the web version.

On the Mobile App

  1. Open the Instagram app and head to your profile.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Tap Accounts Center.
  4. Tap Your information and permissions.
  5. Now, tap Export your information.
  6. Next, tap the Create Export button.
  7. Select the profile you’d like to export information from.
  8. Choose whether to export the information to your device or to an external service.
  9. Here, you can:
    • Choose the information you want to export
    • Select a date range,
    • Choose your preferred file format
    • Select the email address for delivery
  10. Once done, tap the Start Export button.
  11. Enter your account’s password when asked.

On the Web

  1. Visit Instagram.com and sign in to your account.
  2. Click the More button in the sidebar.
  3. Select Settings from the pop-up menu.
  4. Click Accounts Center.
  5. Select the Your information and permissions option in the sidebar, then click Export your Information on the right.
  6. Click the Create Export button.
  7. Select your Instagram profile.
  8. Now, choose whether to export the information to your device or to an external service.
  9. Here, you can customize your export, select your notification email, and choose your preferred format.
  10. Once done, click the Start Export button.
  11. Enter your account’s password when asked

Accessing and managing your downloaded Instagram data

When your Instagram data export is ready, you’ll receive an email stating “Your Meta information download is ready.”

You can either click the link in the email or manually go to the Export Your Information page in Meta’s Accounts Center. Once there, you’ll find your Instagram data archive under Available downloads.

From the moment you receive the email, you’ll have four days to download the file. If you miss this window, the export expires, and you will need to submit a new request.

When you tap the Download button, Instagram will ask you to verify your identity by entering your account password. 

This extra step ensures that only the account owner can access and download the exported data. Once the password is confirmed, the download begins.

After the download completes, you can unzip the file in the Files app on your device and access the exported folders within.

If you choose to export your information directly to an external service or device, Instagram will notify you in two ways.

  • An email confirmation.
  • An in-app notification once the transfer is complete.
Note Instagram may take up to 30 days to prepare and send your export link, especially for accounts with large amounts of data

Taking Control of Your Instagram Data…

Downloading your Instagram data gives you full control over your content and insight into how your account has been used over time. It is also useful for backups if you’re preparing to leave the platform entirely. So, if you’ve ever wondered how much of your digital life lives inside Instagram, this post answers that question completely.

Have you ever downloaded your Instagram data, or are you planning to do it now? Share your experience or questions in the comments below.

FAQs

How often can I download my Instagram data?

There is no strict limit on how often you can request your data. However, frequent requests may take longer to process, especially for large accounts. In most cases, it is best to request a new export only when you actually need an updated copy of your information.

Is downloading Instagram data safe?

Yes. Downloading your Instagram data through the app or Accounts Center is a secure, password-protected process. Only you can request and access the export. That said, the downloaded file contains sensitive personal information, so it should be stored securely and not shared with third-party services or unknown apps.

title.rendered: ChatGPT Voice Feature Will Be Removed From Mac App

content.rendered:
If speaking to ChatGPT on your Mac has become second nature, brace yourself for an upcoming change that might disrupt your routine. OpenAI has announced that the Voice feature in the ChatGPT macOS desktop app will be discontinued on January 15, 2026. After this date, using Voice through the Mac app will no longer be an option.

For those who rely on Voice for daily interactions with ChatGPT, this small update note carries significant consequences.

Table of Contents
  • The Announcement Appeared Discreetly In A Mac App Update
  • What Changes On January 15, 2026
  • Where ChatGPT Voice Will Continue To Work
  • Why OpenAI Is Removing Voice From The Mac App
  • What Mac Users Should Do Now

The Announcement Appeared Discreetly In A Mac App Update

OpenAI included a clear message in the release notes for the ChatGPT Mac app, stating:

  • Voice on the macOS desktop app will be phased out, effective January 15, 2026.
  • OpenAI’s reason for this change is to focus on “more unified and improved voice experiences” across its applications.
  • No other functionalities of ChatGPT on macOS will be affected.

To clarify, this is not about shutting down the entire Mac app or altering ChatGPT as a whole. It is specifically the end of the Voice feature in the native macOS app.

What Changes On January 15, 2026

It is crucial to understand that this is not an abrupt shutdown. It is a planned phase-out.

Once that date arrives:

  • Voice will no longer function within the ChatGPT Mac app.
  • Users relying on the Mac app for spoken interactions will need to move to another supported platform.

OpenAI also stresses that this change does not signal the decline of the Mac app itself. Other macOS features will remain untouched, meaning text-based chats and the core app experience will continue as usual.

Where ChatGPT Voice Will Continue To Work

Although Voice is leaving the Mac app, OpenAI confirms the feature is staying active elsewhere. Voice will continue to be available on:

  • Chatgpt.com through a web browser
  • iOS
  • Android
  • The Windows app

If you prefer speaking instead of typing, or enjoy conversational voice responses, you can still do that. You will just need to use one of these supported platforms instead of the macOS desktop app.

Why OpenAI Is Removing Voice From The Mac App

OpenAI says the decision is driven by a desire for consistency. The company wants to build more unified and improved voice experiences across all its apps.

While OpenAI has not shared technical details or confirmed whether Voice could return to the Mac app in the future, the wording suggests this is more of a restructuring than a rejection of voice interaction. Voice features work best when they feel familiar and reliable across devices, and that level of consistency often requires changes behind the scenes.

Also read: New ChatGPT for Mac Update Adds Game-Changing Record Mode and Cloud Drive Access

What Mac Users Should Do Now

If Voice plays a role in how you use ChatGPT on a Mac, some preparation can help avoid frustration later:

  • Mark January 15, 2026, as the cutoff date for Voice in the Mac app.
  • Try using Voice on chatgpt.com ahead of time so the transition feels natural.
  • If you use Voice across devices, make sure you are comfortable with it on iOS or Android, where support will continue.

While removing a single feature from one app may sound minor, it can feel disruptive when it affects established habits. Still, OpenAI is keeping Voice available in several other places and frames this move as part of a broader effort to improve the overall voice experience rather than eliminate it.

title.rendered: Best Accessories for Apple Watch Ultra 3, Ultra 2, and Ultra in 2026

content.rendered:
The Apple Watch Ultra 3 is the latest and most advanced smartwatch in Apple’s lineup, blending rugged design with cutting-edge technology. Whether you’re diving, hiking, or just using it for everyday wear, it deserves accessories that protect, enhance, and complement its premium build.

That’s why I’ve rounded up some of the best Apple Watch Ultra accessories that boost durability, functionality, and style, all tested and recommended for 2026.

Table of Contents
  • Key Factors to Consider When Choosing Apple Watch Ultra Accessories
    • 1. Compatibility
    • 2. Durability and Build Quality
    • 3. Dust and Water Resistance
    • 4. Comfort and Fit
    • 5. Price versus Features
  • Must-Have Apple Watch Ultra Accessories in 2026
    • Best Apple Watch Ultra Bands and Straps
    • 1. Spigen DuraPro Flex: Best all-around band
    • 2. amBand Titanium Band: Best metal strap
    • 3. NOMAD Sport Band: Best for Fitness & Daily Wear
    • Best Apple Watch Ultra Cases and Screen Protectors
    • 1. Spigen Rugged Armor Case: Best Budget Case
    • 2. amBand Full-Body Protective Case: Best for heavy-duty protection
    • 3. Spigen EZ Fit Screen Protector: Best clarity
    • 4. Ailun Tempered Glass 3-Pack: Best value screen protector
    • Best Apple Watch Ultra Chargers and Stands
    • 1. Native Union Watch Puck: Best travel charger
    • 2. Spigen Charger Stand: Best Desk Setup
    • 3. Anker MagGo Power Bank: Best Portable Charger
    • 4. JOYROOM Portable Keychain Charger: Best Budget-Friendly Charger
  • Get the Most Out of Your Ultra Watch!

Key Factors to Consider When Choosing Apple Watch Ultra Accessories

All the products listed here work seamlessly with the Apple Watch Ultra 3, Ultra 2, and Ultra (49mm). Before buying, keep these points in mind to get the best value for your investment.

1. Compatibility

All Ultra models have a 49mm titanium body, which is larger than standard Apple Watches. Make sure your straps, cases, and screen protectors specify compatibility with Apple Watch Ultra models to ensure a perfect fit.

2. Durability and Build Quality

The Ultra series is made for extreme adventures, so your accessories should match that toughness. Opt for premium, adventure-ready materials that can withstand water, dust, and impact.

3. Dust and Water Resistance

The Apple Watch Ultra 3 is engineered for extreme sports, so go for accessories that also offer IP-rated dust and water resistance for maximum protection during outdoor activities.

4. Comfort and Fit

Since most users wear their Ultra all day, comfort is key. Choose straps and cases with breathable, skin-friendly materials and secure fit mechanisms for prolonged use.

5. Price versus Features

While premium accessories provide more durability and advanced features, there are excellent budget-friendly options too. Below, I’ve included both high-end and affordable picks to suit every type of user.

Must-Have Apple Watch Ultra Accessories in 2026

After months of testing and comparing, here are the top Apple Watch Ultra accessories that truly elevate your smartwatch experience.

Best Apple Watch Ultra Bands and Straps

Looking for the best Apple Watch Ultra strap to match your lifestyle? Whether you need something breathable for workouts or stylish for formal occasions, here are top picks that combine comfort, durability, and functionality.

1. Spigen DuraPro Flex: Best all-around band

The Spigen DuraPro Flex remains one of the most balanced bands for the Ultra series. Made from breathable, sweat-resistant material, it feels featherlight even during long workouts or daily wear. Its minimal yet elegant design works just as well at the gym as it does in business meetings.

Why I love it: it’s affordable, versatile, and incredibly comfortable.

Highlights: breathable and sweatproof, comfortable for all-day use, perfect for workouts and everyday wear.

2. amBand Titanium Band: Best metal strap

For those who prefer a bold, rugged look, the amBand Titanium Band is unmatched. Built from premium titanium alloy, it can take serious hits without showing wear. It’s my go-to band when I want something sturdy yet refined.

Highlights: durable titanium build, scratch-resistant, premium aesthetic.

3. NOMAD Sport Band: Best for Fitness & Daily Wear

The NOMAD Sport Band strikes the perfect balance between comfort and performance. It’s soft, flexible, waterproof, and looks fantastic. Whether you’re training, swimming, or working, this band feels natural and secure on your wrist.

Highlights: soft silicone texture, waterproof, available in multiple stylish colors.

Best Apple Watch Ultra Cases and Screen Protectors

Even though the Ultra 3 is built tough, adding an extra layer of protection keeps it looking new for longer.

Whether you’re into adventure sports or just want to preserve your smartwatch’s pristine look, investing in the best Apple Watch Ultra case and screen protector is a smart move.

1. Spigen Rugged Armor Case: Best Budget Case

The Spigen Rugged Armor is an affordable yet reliable TPU case designed to absorb shocks and prevent scratches. The raised bezels protect the screen from bumps and accidental drops. It’s lightweight, perfectly fitted, and ideal for outdoor enthusiasts.

Highlights: shock-resistant build, raised edges, slim fit.

2. amBand Full-Body Protective Case: Best for heavy-duty protection

If you need full 360° protection, the amBand Full-Body Case with a built-in tempered glass protector is unbeatable. It’s military-grade tested and perfect for high-intensity environments. Despite its ruggedness, it still looks sleek and modern.

Highlights: all-around protection, dustproof, water-resistant, outdoor-ready design.

3. Spigen EZ Fit Screen Protector: Best clarity

The Spigen EZ Fit Tempered Glass offers crystal-clear protection without affecting touch sensitivity. Its included alignment tray makes installation effortless and bubble-free.

Highlights: 9H tempered glass, precise fit, smooth touch response.

4. Ailun Tempered Glass 3-Pack: Best value screen protector

The Ailun 3-Pack is perfect for budget-conscious users who don’t want to compromise on quality. Each protector provides strong 9H hardness and anti-fingerprint coating, ensuring your display remains scratch-free and clean.

Best Apple Watch Ultra Chargers and Stands

The Apple Watch Ultra charges magnetically by default, but there are faster and more travel-friendly chargers worth considering.

1. Native Union Watch Puck: Best travel charger

Compact, stylish, and Apple MFi-certified, the Native Union Watch Puck is ideal for travelers. Its aluminum body feels premium, and it delivers efficient charging wherever you go.

Highlights: portable, minimalist design, certified safe charging.

2. Spigen Charger Stand: Best Desk Setup

For nightstands or workstations, the Spigen Charger Stand keeps your watch upright and visible while charging. The non-slip base adds stability, and the angled stand makes it easy to check notifications or the time.

Highlights: anti-slip grip, strong build, perfect for home or office.

3. Anker MagGo Power Bank: Best Portable Charger

The Anker MagGo 5000mAh Power Bank is a wireless charger that delivers multiple charges for your Apple Watch Ultra on the go. It’s light, travel-friendly, and Apple-certified for reliable power.

Highlights: up to 3 full charges, USB-C support, pocket-size convenience.

4. JOYROOM Portable Keychain Charger: Best Budget-Friendly Charger

The JOYROOM Keychain Charger is a tiny yet practical backup option. It clips onto your keys, features a built-in battery, and works perfectly with all Apple Watch Ultra models.

Highlights: keychain design, built-in power, affordable and handy.

Get the Most Out of Your Ultra Watch!

That wraps up my curated list of the best Apple Watch Ultra 3, Ultra 2, and Ultra accessories to buy in 2026. From rugged cases to premium titanium bands and travel-friendly chargers, these products are designed to enhance your Apple Watch experience every day.

Which of these accessories caught your eye? Share your favorite picks or personal recommendations in the comments below.

@graph.name: Spigen DuraPro Flex Apple Watch Band
@graph.description: The Spigen DuraPro Flex remains one of the most balanced bands for the Ultra series. Made from breathable, sweat-resistant material, it feels featherlight even during long workouts or daily wear. Its minimal yet elegant design works just as well at the gym as it does in business meetings.

@graph.name: amBand M1 Sport Case Band
@graph.description: For those who prefer a bold, rugged look, the amBand Titanium Band is unmatched. Built from premium titanium alloy, it can take serious hits without showing wear. It’s my go-to band when I want something sturdy yet refined.

@graph.name: NOMAD Sport Band V2
@graph.description: The NOMAD Sport Band strikes the perfect balance between comfort and performance. It’s soft, flexible, waterproof, and looks fantastic. Whether you’re training, swimming, or working, this band feels natural and secure on your wrist.

@graph.name: Spigen Case for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: The Spigen Rugged Armor is an affordable yet reliable TPU case designed to absorb shocks and prevent scratches. The raised bezels protect the screen from bumps and accidental drops. It’s lightweight, perfectly fitted, and ideal for outdoor enthusiasts.

@graph.name: amBand Full-Body Protective Case
@graph.description: If you need full 360° protection, the amBand Full-Body Case with a built-in tempered glass protector is unbeatable. It’s military-grade tested and perfect for high-intensity environments. Despite its ruggedness, it still looks sleek and modern.

@graph.name: Spigen EZ Fit Screen Protector
@graph.description: The Spigen EZ Fit Tempered Glass offers crystal-clear protection without affecting touch sensitivity. Its included alignment tray makes installation effortless and bubble-free.

@graph.name: Ailun Tempered Glass 3-Pack
@graph.description: The Ailun 3-Pack is perfect for budget-conscious users who don’t want to compromise on quality. Each protector provides strong 9H hardness and anti-fingerprint coating, ensuring your display remains scratch-free and clean.

@graph.name: Native Union Watch Portable USB-C Apple Watch Magnetic Charger
@graph.description: Compact, stylish, and Apple MFi-certified, the Native Union Watch Puck is ideal for travelers. Its aluminum body feels premium, and it delivers efficient charging wherever you go.

@graph.name: Spigen Apple Watch Charger Stand
@graph.description: For nightstands or workstations, the Spigen Charger Stand keeps your watch upright and visible while charging. The non-slip base adds stability, and the angled stand makes it easy to check notifications or the time.

@graph.name: Anker MagGo Power Bank for Apple Watch
@graph.description: The Anker MagGo 5000mAh Power Bank is a wireless charger that delivers multiple charges for your Apple Watch Ultra on the go. It’s light, travel-friendly, and Apple-certified for reliable power.

@graph.name: JOYROOM Portable 2000mAh Wireless Apple Watch Charger
@graph.description: The JOYROOM Keychain Charger is a tiny yet practical backup option. It clips onto your keys, features a built-in battery, and works perfectly with all Apple Watch Ultra models.

title.rendered: How to Know Which Apple Watch You Have (2026 Edition)

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Check the back of your Apple Watch: The case back lists the series name, size, material, water resistance, and depth rating, helping you quickly confirm your model.
  • Check the original box for model number and specs: The box label shows your Apple Watch’s series, serial, IMEI, region, and band variant, offering the most accurate identification.
  • Use iPhone settings to identify your Apple Watch: Open Settings > Apple ID > your Apple Watch to see the model, serial, and version for quick verification.
  • Confirm if your Apple Watch is original: Enter your serial number on checkcoverage.apple.com to verify authenticity, warranty status, and purchase details.
  • Check if your Apple Watch is refurbished: The model number prefix reveals its status—M for new, F for refurbished, or N for an Apple replacement.

Unless you compare them side by side, almost all the latest Apple Watch models look nearly identical at first glance. That’s why when you’re buying new bands, selling a pre-owned watch, upgrading to watchOS 26, or troubleshooting, you may wonder: “Which Apple Watch do I have?”

This guide shows you three simple ways to identify your Apple Watch model, plus a bonus tip to verify if your Apple Watch is original. Let’s dive in.

Table of Contents
  • How Do I Know Which Apple Watch I Have?
    • 1. Check the Back of Your Apple Watch
    • 2. Check the Original Box for the Model Number & Specs
    • 3. Use iPhone Settings to Identify Your Apple Watch
  • How to Know If Your Apple Watch is Original
  • Find Out Who Your Wrist Buddy is!

How Do I Know Which Apple Watch I Have?

Here are three reliable methods: the first two are fast, the third gives the full technical breakdown about model number, case size, origin, and more (useful for accessories, trade-in, repair, etc).

1. Check the Back of Your Apple Watch

Flip over your watch and look for the engraving on the case back. Most models will have:

  • Series name (e.g., “Watch Series 11”, “Watch Ultra”, “Watch SE”)
  • Case size (e.g., 42 mm, 46 mm, 49 mm)
  • Materials (Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Titanium)
  • Connectivity type (GPS or GPS + Cellular)
  • Water resistance rating
  • Maximum depth

So if you see a 49 mm Titanium case and “Watch Ultra” on the back, you’re likely dealing with “Ultra” model (and could be the new Ultra 3 or earlier Ultra). For Series 11 you’ll see that series name rather than “Series 10”.

With this information, you will be able to find the right Apple Watch accessories, software, and services for your wearable.

2. Check the Original Box for the Model Number & Specs

If you still have the original packaging, the back label is very informative. You’ll find:

  • Series name & case size
  • Model number (starts with “Axxxx”)
  • Serial number, IMEI/EID if Cellular model
  • Band size/type
  • Region / variant information

Once you have the model number, you can compare it to the reference list below to identify exactly which Apple Watch variant (region, GPS vs Cellular, size) you have.

  • Apple Watch Series 11:
    • A3331: 42 mm (GPS); North America, Europe, Asia Pacific
    • A3450: 42 mm (GPS); China mainland
    • A3333: 46 mm (GPS); North America, Europe, Asia Pacific
    • A3451: 46 mm (GPS); China mainland
    • A3335: 42 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America, Europe, Asia Pacific
    • A3452: 42 mm (GPS + Cellular); China mainland
    • A3337: 46 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America, Europe, Asia Pacific
    • A3453: 46 mm (GPS + Cellular); China mainland
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3:
    • A3281: 49 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America, Europe, Asia Pacific
    • A3282: 49 mm (GPS + Cellular) China mainland
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2:
    • A2986: 49 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America, Europe & Asia-Pacific
    • A2987: 49 mm (GPS + Cellular); China mainland
  • Apple Watch Series 9 models:
    • A2978: 41 mm (GPS)
    • A2980: 45 mm (GPS)
    • A2982: 41 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America, Europe & Asia Pacific
    • A2983: 41 mm (GPS + Cellular); China mainland
    • A2984: 45 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America, Europe & Asia Pacific
    • A2985: 45 mm (GPS + Cellular); China mainland
  • Apple Watch Ultra:
    • A2622: 49 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America
    • A2684: 49 mm (GPS + Cellular); Europe & Asia-Pacific
    • A2859: 49 mm (GPS + Cellular); China mainland
  • Apple Watch Series 8 models:

    • A3329: 46 mm (GPS + Cellular); China mainland
  • Apple Watch SE (Second Generation)
    • A2722: 40 mm (GPS)

    • A2856: 44 mm (GPS + Cellular); China
  • Apple Watch SE:
    • A2351: 40 mm (GPS)
    • A2352: 44 mm (GPS)
    • A2353: 40 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America
    • A2355: 40 mm (GPS + Cellular); Europe, Asia Pacific & China
    • A2354: 44 mm (GPS + Cellular); North America
    • A2356: 44 mm (GPS + Cellular); Europe, Asia Pacific & China

3. Use iPhone Settings to Identify Your Apple Watch

Similarly to the Watch app, the Settings app on your iPhone provides access to essential information regarding your Apple Watch.

  1. Launch the Settings app →Tap your Apple ID or profile.
  2. Scroll down and select your paired Apple Watch.
    Even here, you can find the name of the Watch series. Take the next step for more details.
  3. Under DEVICE INFO, you will find important parameters of your Apple Watch, such as Model, Version, Serial Number, and IMEI.

You can use the serial number displayed here to confirm whether your Apple Watch is original, the steps for which are mentioned below.

How to Know If Your Apple Watch is Original

One of the main reasons why many of you might be searching for your Apple Watch serial number is to ensure that it’s authentic. Here’s how you can check if your Apple Watch is original or not:

  1. Visit the official page of checkcoverage.apple.com.
  2. Enter your Apple Watch serial number.
  3. Now, enter the code displayed on your screen.
  4. Hit Submit.

  5. If your Apple Watch is authentic, you will be able to view its details like purchase date, warranty status, eligibility for AppleCare etc.
  6. However, if nothing comes up, you’re probably carrying a fake Apple Watch.

Also, while you are at it, you may even check if your iPhone is original or not.

Find Out Who Your Wrist Buddy is!

I hope these straightforward methods help you stay informed about your Apple Watch no matter where you go. One or the other, this information may come in handy.

Which method did you find the easiest? Please let me know in the comments below.

FAQs

Is there a quick way to visually differentiate between Apple Watch models?

Absolutely! Pay attention to the design elements. The Series 7, for example, has a larger and more rounded display compared to earlier models.

How do I know if my Apple Watch is refurbished?

Examining the model number can help you determine if your Apple Watch is refurbished. If the model number starts with M, it was bought new from Apple. If it begins with F, it was refurbished by Apple or a carrier. If it begins with N, it is a replacement device provided by Apple.

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! Pay attention to the design elements. The Series 7, for example, has a larger and more rounded display compared to earlier models.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my Apple Watch is refurbished?

acceptedAnswer.text: Examining the model number can help you determine if your Apple Watch is refurbished. If the model number starts with M, it was bought new from Apple. title.rendered: How to Use Edge Light Video Effects on Mac for Video Calls

content.rendered:
Starting with macOS Tahoe 26.2, Apple introduced a new video conferencing feature called Edge Light. When enabled, it casts a virtual ring of light around your display, creating a soft, natural glow on your face during video calls, even in dimly lit rooms. You no longer need external lighting equipment or to switch rooms for a call, as your Mac can now automatically illuminate your face in low-light environments.

However, there is a limitation. Edge Light does not activate automatically on all Macs. Keep reading to learn what the Edge Light feature is, how it works, and how to enable it on your Mac.

While using Edge Light for immersive video calls, incoming iPhone calls on your Mac can be distracting. If you want to stop these interruptions, check out how to turn off phone calls on a Mac.

Table of Contents
  • What is Edge Light on macOS and How It Works?
  • Which Macs Support Edge Light?
  • How to Turn On Edge Light on Your Mac
    • Enable Automatic Edge Light Activation on Newer Macs
  • Wrapping Up

What is Edge Light on macOS and How It Works?

Edge Light is Apple’s latest video effect that mimics a real ring light. Your Mac’s display becomes the light source, so you don’t need extra gear to look brighter and clearer on camera.

It uses the Mac’s Neural Engine to detect your face, determine its position, and adjust the lighting to ensure it looks balanced and natural. The Image Signal Processor also tweaks brightness in real time to match your environment.

Apple added a smart touch: the lights fade away when your mouse approaches the screen edge, so the feature never gets in your way.

Which Macs Support Edge Light?

Edge Light is available on all Apple Silicon Macs and also works with Apple’s Studio Display when it is connected to a supported Mac. This ensures consistent lighting across built-in and external display setups.

On most Macs, Edge Light needs to be enabled manually during video calls. However, Mac models released in 2024 or later can activate the feature automatically when the system detects low-light conditions.

The feature also supports external cameras, which makes it equally useful for professionals using dedicated webcams and for everyday users relying on their Mac’s built-in camera.

How to Turn On Edge Light on Your Mac

You can enable Edge Light from the video effects panel, alongside tools like Portrait Mode, Studio Light, Reactions, and Backgrounds. It works with major video apps, including FaceTime, Zoom, and Webex. Here’s how:

  1. Open FaceTime or another supported video calling app (Zoom or Webex, for example).
  2. Now, click the green FaceTime icon in the top menu bar.
  3. Select Edge Light from the drop-down menu (video effects panel).
  4. Click the down chevron next to Edge Light to access customization options:
    • Use the Brightness slider to adjust lighting intensity.
    • Use the Warmth slider to fine-tune the color temperature.

Enable Automatic Edge Light Activation on Newer Macs

If you own a Mac released in 2024 or later, you can enable automatic Edge Light activation. Once turned on, your Mac detects low-light conditions and automatically activates Edge Light without any manual input. To enable this:

  1. Open the video call effects drop-down menu.
  2. Here, look for the Automatic toggle located directly below the expanded Edge Light options.

Wrapping Up

Although a minor addition for most users, Edge Light is a practical and meaningful improvement for anyone who regularly takes video calls on a Mac. With support for all Apple silicon Macs, compatibility with external cameras, and automatic activation on newer models, Edge Light fits naturally into both everyday video calls and professional setups.

Have you tried Edge Light yet? Let us know how it works for you in the comments.

title.rendered: Best Flash Drives for iPhone: Top 6 Picks

content.rendered:
If you’re like me, your iPhone’s storage is likely filled with photos, videos, and apps. As such, running out of storage space is a common concern. While iCloud is great and quite convenient, it’s not ideal, especially when you’re offline or dealing with large files. This is where iPhone flash drives come in. In addition to expanding your iPhone’s storage, these drives let you transfer files between your iPhone and other devices.

Whether you’re a professional photographer needing extra storage on the go or someone who just wants to back up photos and videos quickly, here are some of the best flash drives for your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • How to Choose the Right Flash Drive for Your iPhone
  • Best Flash Drives to Back Up Your iPhone
    • 1. SanDisk Ultra Dual Drive Go: Best Type-C Flash Drive
    • 2. SSK Dual Drive External SSD Stick: For Power Users
    • 3. Samsung Type-C USB Flash Drive: Premium Choice
    • 4. PNY Duo Link V3 Flash Drive: Superfast Transfers
    • 5. Techkey MFi Certified 3-in-1 Flash Drive: Best for Multi-device Use
    • 6. EATOP 4-in-1 Flash Drive: Compact Yet Versatile
  • Which iPhone Flash Drive is Right for You?
  • Final Thoughts

How to Choose the Right Flash Drive for Your iPhone

When selecting a flash drive for your iPhone, consider several factors to ensure you make the right choice.

  • Compatibility: Ensure the flash drive you purchase is compatible with your iPhone model. Some drives include both Lightning and USB-C connectors, making them versatile for use with different Apple devices.
  • Storage capacity: Depending on your needs, choose a flash drive with enough storage to accommodate your files.
  • Transfer speed: Faster transfer speeds save time, especially when handling large files such as videos. Look for drives that support USB 3.0 or higher for optimal performance. However, note that only the iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max support USB 2.0 transfer speeds.
  • Build quality and design: A sturdy, well-designed flash drive can withstand daily wear and tear. Some drives also include features such as keychain loops, making them easier to carry.

Best Flash Drives to Back Up Your iPhone

Choose the best iPhone flash drive based on your storage needs, device compatibility, and everyday usage. 

1. SanDisk Ultra Dual Drive Go: Best Type-C Flash Drive

  • Capacities: 32GB, 64GB, 128GB, 256GB, 512GB, 1TB 
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 1 
  • Connector: USB-C and USB-A 

If you want a simple, reliable storage upgrade for your iPhone, this SanDisk flash drive nails it. It’s built with USB-C, so you can plug it right into iPhone 15 or later, iPad, and Mac. You get fast transfer speeds (400MB/s), a solid metal build, and automatic photo backup with the SanDisk Memory Zone app.  

For older iPhones with Lightning connectors, you can buy SanDisk iXpand Flash Drive Go. 

Good for: Everyday users and students 

2. SSK Dual Drive External SSD Stick: For Power Users

  • Capacities: 1TB, 2TB 
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 2 
  • Connector: USB-C and USB-A 

Want a powerful yet compact SSD drive for your iPhone? This SSK Solid State flash drive offers up to 550MB/s transfer speed. It has both USB Type-C and Type-A connectors with plug-and-play support, so you can use it with your iPhone and older laptops/desktops.  

Thanks to the high-grade zinc alloy housing and double-head protection design, the adapter is sturdy and wear-resistant. Moreover, fast heat dissipation protects your data well. You also get a leather pouch to carry the flash drive easily.  

Good for: If you want more storage space with good transfer speed 

3. Samsung Type-C USB Flash Drive: Premium Choice

  • Capacities: 64GB, 128GB, 256GB, 512GB 
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 1 
  • Connector: USB-C 

Samsung’s USB-C flash drive is one of the more polished options in terms of design and reliability. It’s rugged, splash-resistant, and doesn’t get damaged by shock, magnet, temperature, and X-ray.  

With 400MB/s transfer speed, you can move files smoothly between your iPhone and other USB-C devices. The drive is also backward compatible with USB 3.0/2.0. You can be worry-free with Samsung’s flash memory technology and a 5-year limited warranty.  

Good for: Users who want quality and long-term reliable performance. 

4. PNY Duo Link V3 Flash Drive: Superfast Transfers

  • Capacities: 256GB, 512GB, 1TB, 2TB 
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 2 
  • Connector: USB-C and USB-A 

PNY’s flash drive is a reliable mid-range pick with USB-C connectivity, which works smoothly with modern iPhones. It can reach exceptional read and write speeds of up to 1000 MB/s and 800 MB/s, respectively. 

With a two-year guaranteed warranty, this elegant swivel design is made of high-quality metal parts for maximum durability and mobility. If you want no-frills storage that offers professional functionality, this delivers. 

Good for: Professionals needing high speed data transfer speed. 

5. Techkey MFi Certified 3-in-1 Flash Drive: Best for Multi-device Use

  • Capacities: 128GB, 256GB, 512GB 
  • Interface: USB 3.0 
  • Connector: Lightning, USB-C, and USB-A 

This Techkey flash drive comes with multiple connectors, including Lightning, USB-C, and standard USB. It is MFi certified, meaning it’s made to work with iPhone without weird issues. You can back up photos in one-click, share files across platforms, and even use an app to encrypt specific files or the whole drive. 

Moreover, the flash drive is dustproof, drop-proof, and anti-magnetic thanks to premium metal housing. The only downside is its read and write speeds are slower than the others on the list. 

Good for: Users with different devices

6. EATOP 4-in-1 Flash Drive: Compact Yet Versatile

  • Capacities: 128GB256GB, 512GB 
  • Interface: USB 3.0 
  • Connector: Lightning, USB-C, USB-A, and Micro-USB 

The EATOP flash drive also packs multiple connectors, so you can back up or access files across phones and computers. You can even take photos and videos and store it straight to the drive without saving them onto your phone first.  

This also applies to the media stored on the stick. Just plug it into your iPhone and share the photo and video directly with your family, friends, or on social media. However, this also have slower data transfers. 

Good for: Photographers, travelers or anyone who wants a single storage solution for all their devices.

Which iPhone Flash Drive is Right for You? 

Choosing the right iPhone flash drive doesn’t have to be complicated. The key is to match the drive with how you actually use your phone.

Final Thoughts 

At the end of the day, a good iPhone flash drive is all about simplicity, compatibility, and reliability. Whether you’re clearing space, backing up memories, or sharing files between devices, the right flash drive can make your iPhone experience much smoother. 

Take a moment to think about your storage needs, pick the drive that fits your daily use, and enjoy the freedom of extra space. Which one did you add to the cart? Let us know your comments below.

@graph.name: SanDisk Ultra Dual Drive Go
@graph.description: It’s built with USB-C, so you can plug it right into iPhone 15 or later, iPad, and Mac. You get fast transfer speeds (400MB/s), a solid metal build, and automatic photo backup with the SanDisk Memory Zone app.

@graph.name: SSK Dual Drive External SSD Stick
@graph.description: This SSK Solid State flash drive offers up to 550MB/s transfer speed. It has both USB Type-C and Type-A connectors with plug-and-play support, so you can use it with your iPhone and older laptops/desktops. Thanks to the high-grade zinc alloy housing and double-head protection design, the adapter is sturdy and wear-resistant.

@graph.name: Samsung Type-C USB Flash Drive
@graph.description: Samsung’s USB-C flash drive is one of the more polished options in terms of design and reliability. It’s rugged, splash-resistant, and doesn’t get damaged by shock, magnet, temperature, and X-ray. With 400MB/s transfer speed, you can move files smoothly between your iPhone and other USB-C devices. The drive is also backward compatible with USB 3.0/2.0. You can be worry-free with Samsung’s flash memory technology and a 5-year limited warranty.

@graph.name: PNY Duo Link V3 Flash Drive
@graph.description: PNY’s flash drive is a reliable mid-range pick with USB-C connectivity, which works smoothly with modern iPhones. It can reach exceptional read and write speeds of up to 1000 MB/s and 800 MB/s, respectively. With a two-year guaranteed warranty, this elegant swivel design is made of high-quality metal parts for maximum durability and mobility.

@graph.name: Techkey MFi Certified 3-in-1 Flash Drive
@graph.description: This Techkey flash drive comes with multiple connectors, including Lightning, USB-C, and standard USB. It is MFi certified, meaning it’s made to work with iPhone without weird issues. You can back up photos in one-click, share files across platforms, and even use an app to encrypt specific files or the whole drive. Moreover, the flash drive is dustproof, drop-proof, and anti-magnetic thanks to premium metal housing.

@graph.name: EATOP 4-in-1 Flash Drive
@graph.description: The EATOP flash drive also packs multiple connectors, so you can back up or access files across phones and computers. You can even take photos and videos and store it straight to the drive without saving them onto your phone first. This also applies to the media stored on the stick. Just plug it into your iPhone and share the photo and video directly with your family, friends, or on social media.

title.rendered: Apple’s Next iMac Upgrade Might Be All About OLED

content.rendered:
The 24-inch iMac has been Apple’s “everything in one box” Mac for people who want a clean desk and an easy setup. Now, a new supply-chain report suggests Apple is preparing a display upgrade that could be the biggest change to the iMac in years: moving to an OLED screen, with development targeting 2027.

A Supply-Chain Report Points to a 2027 OLED iMac

According to a report from The Elec, Apple has sent requests for information (RFIs) to Samsung Display and LG Display about building a 24-inch OLED panel for a future iMac.

An RFI is an early but meaningful step. It’s the point where a company shares what it wants, and suppliers respond with how they’d build it, what it would cost, and when they could deliver.

The same report says Apple is aiming to complete OLED panel development by 2027 or 2028, though the iMac that uses it could arrive after that.

What the Rumored 24-Inch OLED iMac Display Could Look Like

If the reported specs hold, Apple’s OLED iMac would keep the familiar size and sharpness, but push the display further:

  • 24-inch OLED panel
  • 218 pixels per inch (PPI): the same pixel density as the current 24-inch iMac
  • Up to 600 nits brightness: a step up from the current model’s 500 nits

In other words, this doesn’t sound like a reinvention of the iMac’s size or resolution. It sounds like Apple trying to make the screen look brighter, punchier, and more premium, without changing the core iMac formula.

Also Read: Leaked Prototype Confirms Apple Considered iMac Logo Placement

Why Oled Could Be a Bigger Deal Than “Just Brighter”

Brightness is the headline, but OLED’s real value is usually what happens when the screen isn’t blasting full white.

OLED technology is known for:

  • Deeper blacks and higher contrast (because pixels can turn off individually)
  • Better power efficiency in many scenarios
  • A generally more “ink-like” look for dark UI elements, photos, and video

On a desktop, that could translate into a screen that feels more vivid in everyday use, whether you’re editing images, watching video, or simply working in apps that use darker interface elements.

The Tricky Part: The Kind of OLED Apple Wants

One of the most interesting details in the report is that Apple may face a “pick your compromise” moment with OLED panel technology, especially at desktop sizes.

The Elec says Samsung and LG are expected to propose their established large-format OLED approaches:

  • Samsung: QD-OLED, which uses blue OLED light and a quantum-dot layer to create color
  • LG Display: W-OLED, which uses a white-light source and color filters

The report also notes both companies are developing 5-stack OLED designs (adding an extra green layer) to help increase brightness compared to current 4-stack designs.

Meanwhile, Apple is said to prefer RGB OLED, where red, green, and blue light are produced at the subpixel level, often associated with strong color and efficiency. The catch: the report suggests RGB OLED still hasn’t scaled reliably to the 20–30 inch range needed for desktop displays, which is why the first OLED iMac may use different OLED methods.

What to Watch Next

Right now, this story is less about a launch date and more about a direction: Apple appears to be laying the groundwork for an OLED iMac, and the timeline being discussed points to 2027 at the earliest or, possibly, later.

If you’re following the iMac closely, the next clues won’t just be about when an OLED iMac ships, but which OLED technology Apple chooses first, and whether it’s willing to bring OLED to a mainstream iMac before its preferred approach is ready at desktop scale.

title.rendered: You Can Now Use Apple Music Inside ChatGPT: Here’s How

content.rendered:
Apple Music is now available inside ChatGPT. While it does not generate music on demand, it can create playlists that match your vibe and play songs you vaguely describe. Here’s how to use Apple Music in ChatGPT and what you can do with it.

Table of Contents
  • Understanding Apple Music Integration with ChatGPT
  • Prerequisites for Apple Music Integration
  • How to Use the Apple Music App on ChatGPT
  • Features and Benefits of Using Apple Music Inside ChatGPT
  • Best Practices for Using Apple Music with ChatGPT
  • How to Fix Apple Music Not Showing in ChatGPT
  • Conclusion

Understanding Apple Music Integration with ChatGPT

First, this does not fully integrate music streaming inside ChatGPT. The implementation is similar to the Spotify integration that launched earlier this year. You can ask ChatGPT to suggest songs or create playlists that match your mood using natural language. It searches Apple Music’s catalog to do this. When you select a song or playlist, it opens in the Apple Music app itself. ChatGPT works more like a thinking layer here.

That said, its playlist creation is far more impressive than the generic mood-based playlists Apple Music usually suggests. It can handle complex prompts and create playlists with songs only from the last five years, exclude specific artists, stick to a particular genre and mood, or even focus on songs about a specific topic. You just need to connect your Apple Music account and start prompting.

You don’t need a subscription to explore or preview songs. But if you do have Apple Music, you get more features, like saving tracks to your library or opening playlists directly in the Apple Music app.

Prerequisites for Apple Music Integration

Before you start, here’s what you need:

  • A free OpenAI account (ChatGPT).
  • Access to ChatGPT on web, iOS, macOS, or desktop.
  • Optional: An active Apple Music subscription for full features.
  • Your Apple ID is used to authorize the connection.

How to Use the Apple Music App on ChatGPT

I am using the web version here, but the steps are nearly the same on the ChatGPT app for iPhone or Android. The setup takes less than a minute. Here is how to do it.

  1. Go to chatgpt.com/apps or open the “Apps” tab in ChatGPT (web, iOS, or Mac app).
  2. Find Apple Music and tap to connect.
  3. Sign in with your Apple ID to authorize ChatGPT.
  4. You’re done! Now you can:
    • Use “/Apple Music” to begin prompts
    • Or just select it from the app list inside ChatGPT

Once connected, ChatGPT may automatically use Apple Music when your prompt includes music; there’s no need to specify it explicitly each time.

Features and Benefits of Using Apple Music Inside ChatGPT

Apple Music inside ChatGPT is built around intent. Instead of browsing or relying on algorithms, you tell ChatGPT exactly what you want, and it uses Apple Music’s catalog to do the work for you.

  • Discover music by describing a mood, vibe, similar song, ad, movie scene, or theme.
  • Create playlists using detailed prompts like genre, mood, BPM, release period, language, or artist exclusions.
  • Refine playlists in the same chat by changing the vibe, adding or removing songs, or renaming them.
  • Save songs, albums, or full playlists to your Apple Music library if you have a subscription.
  • Listen to 30-second song previews directly inside ChatGPT without a subscription.
  • Open and play full songs and playlists in the Apple Music app if you are a subscriber.
  • Use generated playlists across iPhone, iPad, Mac, CarPlay, and HomePod without extra setup.
  • Built on a structure that can later support features like lyrics, credits, shared playlists, and collaboration.

There is no extra setup beyond linking your Apple Music account. Playback stays native to Apple Music, so your listening history, recommendations, and downloads continue to work as usual.

Best Practices for Using Apple Music with ChatGPT

If you want more accurate playlists and song suggestions, how you prompt matters. A few small tweaks can noticeably improve the results.

  • Be specific with prompts. Instead of saying “chill music,” try something like “lofi jazz for late night study sessions.”
  • Add clear filters. Mention genre, mood, tempo, release period, or artists you want to include or avoid.
  • Use previews before saving. Listen to the short clips to make sure the playlist matches what you want.
  • Keep your accounts connected. Make sure ChatGPT stays linked to your Apple Music account for saving and playback.
  • Review permissions when needed. You can disconnect Apple Music from ChatGPT at any time through settings.

How to Fix Apple Music Not Showing in ChatGPT

If you don’t see Apple Music in the Apps tab:

  • Make sure you’re on the latest version of ChatGPT (web or app)
  • Check your region to see if feature rollout may vary
  • Restart ChatGPT or log out and back in
  • Try accessing from chatgpt.com/apps directly
  • If still missing, wait a bit. OpenAI is still rolling this out globally

Conclusion

Apple Music inside ChatGPT changes how you find and build playlists. Instead of searching manually, you describe what you want and let ChatGPT handle discovery using Apple Music’s catalog.

You can explore and preview music without a subscription. With a subscription, you can save playlists and start listening instantly in the Apple Music app.

If you already use Apple Music, this integration is worth trying for faster discovery and more control over your playlists.

FAQs

Can I use Apple Music inside ChatGPT for free?

Yes. You can search the catalog, discover songs, create playlists, and listen to 30-second previews. An Apple Music subscription is only needed to save songs or play them in full.

Is my listening data shared between Apple Music and ChatGPT?

No. ChatGPT doesn’t access your listening history or existing playlists. It can add content to your library (with permission), but doesn’t read from it.

What devices support Apple Music integration with ChatGPT?

You can use it on:

  • Web browser (chatgpt.com)
  • iOS app (iPhone/iPad)
  • Mac desktop app
  • Android support is expected soon.

  • Spotify vs YouTube Music: Quick comparison
  • Apple Music with New Features in iOS 27
  • How to create a Shared Album on iPhone

mainEntity.name: Can too many effects hurt engagement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Overusing effects can distract viewers and make content feel cluttered or inconsistent. Effects are most effective when they support the story or mood rather than compete with it.

mainEntity.name: Are filters and effects free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instagram’s built-in filters and most AR effects are free. While some third-party apps sell presets or editing tools, Instagram itself does not charge for filters or effects.

mainEntity.name: Can I use my own music in Quick Cut?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Quick Cut only supports songs available in Snapchat’s built-in music library. You cannot upload or use custom audio tracks.

mainEntity.name: Is Snapchat Quick Cut available for all devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, Quick Cut is available on the iOS mobile app, and will soon roll out for Android and other devices. It is not supported on Snapchat Web.

mainEntity.name: How often can I download my Instagram data?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no strict limit on how often you can request your data. However, frequent requests may take longer to process, especially for large accounts. In most cases, it is best to request a new export only when you actually need an updated copy of your information.

mainEntity.name: Is downloading Instagram data safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Downloading your Instagram data through the app or Accounts Center is a secure, password-protected process. Only you can request and access the export. That said, the downloaded file contains sensitive personal information, so it should be stored securely and not shared with third-party services or unknown apps.

mainEntity.name: Is there a quick way to visually differentiate between Apple Watch models?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! Pay attention to the design elements. The Series 7, for example, has a larger and more rounded display compared to earlier models.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my Apple Watch is refurbished?

acceptedAnswer.text: Examining the model number can help you determine if your Apple Watch is refurbished. If the model number starts with M, it was bought new from Apple. If it begins with F, it was refurbished by Apple or a carrier. If it begins with N, it is a replacement device provided by Apple.

title.rendered: Best Wireless CarPlay Adapters in 2026: Top Picks for Every Car

content.rendered:
Wireless Apple CarPlay makes driving easier, safer, and more enjoyable, but dealing with cables can still be annoying. That’s where wireless CarPlay adapters come in. These small devices let you enjoy CarPlay features without plugging in your iPhone every time you get in the car.

In this article, we’ll explore the best wireless CarPlay adapters available and compare their features, compatibility, and performance.

Table of Contents
  • What Is a Wireless CarPlay Adapter, and Why Do You Need One?
  • Key Features to Look for in a Wireless CarPlay Adapter
  • 5 Best Wireless CarPlay Adapters
    • 1. Jemluse Wireless CarPlay Adapter: Best Overall Value
    • 2. OTTOCAST Mini Cube 3.0: Best Premium Performance
    • 3. Carlinkit Wireless CarPlay Adapters: Best for Power Users & Tesla Owners
    • 4. Car and Driver IntelliDash Pro X10: Best Built-In Display Option
    • 5. Burnt Sugar Wireless CarPlay Ultra Mini: Best Budget Pick
  • How to Set Up Your Wireless CarPlay Adapter
  • Enjoy CarPlay with Wireless Convenience!

What Is a Wireless CarPlay Adapter, and Why Do You Need One?

A wireless CarPlay adapter is a small device that plugs into your car’s USB port and makes Apple CarPlay work without a cable. If your car already supports wired CarPlay, the adapter serves as a bridge between your iPhone and the car’s system via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.

Once it’s set up, CarPlay connects automatically every time you start the car. Instead of plugging in your iPhone repeatedly, you just get in, start the engine, and CarPlay appears on the screen automatically.

Benefits of CarPlay adapters:

  • No more cables: Cables wear out, get tangled, or are simply easy to forget. A wireless adapter removes that daily hassle.
  • Faster and more convenient starts: With wireless CarPlay, your navigation, music, and calls are ready within seconds of starting the car.
  • Cleaner car interior: No wires hanging from the dashboard means a cleaner, more organized look.
  • Same CarPlay features, just wireless: You still get Apple Maps, Google Maps, Spotify, Siri, calls, messages, and all your favorite CarPlay apps.

Key Features to Look for in a Wireless CarPlay Adapter

It’s important to know what to look for when purchasing a wireless CarPlay Adapter. To help you out, we follow stringent editorial guidelines and thoroughly test products before recommending them to you.

Based on our years of expertise and knowledge of wired and wireless Apple CarPlay, below are the key features you should look for in a wireless CarPlay adapter.

  • Compatibility: Ensure the adapter is compatible with both your iPhone model and your car’s infotainment system. Some adapters are universal, while others are tailored to specific car brands or models.
  • Ease of Setup: Look for an adapter with a quick, straightforward installation process. Plug-and-play devices are especially convenient, requiring minimal technical knowledge to set up.
  • Connection Stability: Choose an adapter that provides reliable Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity, which is crucial for uninterrupted performance.
  • Quick & Automatic Connection: Choose an adapter with a fast boot time so CarPlay activates quickly after you start your car. This ensures you don’t have to wait to access navigation, music, or calls.
  • Price and Warranty: Compare prices to find an adapter that offers the best value for its features. A warranty or customer support can provide peace of mind in case of issues.

5 Best Wireless CarPlay Adapters

Here are my top picks to help you choose the right one for your car and daily driving needs.

1. Jemluse Wireless CarPlay Adapter: Best Overall Value 

The Jemluse Wireless CarPlay Adapter is one of the best-balanced options available in 2026. It’s small, lightweight, and made from aviation aluminum alloy, toughened glass, and high-density braids for durability. You can enjoy all the original controls, including steering wheels and touchscreen.

Moreover, the 5.8 GHz Wi-Fi, 5.3 Bluetooth, and 8-core processor provide a stable, low-lag connection for Apple Maps, Spotify, and phone calls. Thanks to the unique black 7A chip, the adapter is anti-corrosive and resistant to high temperatures.

Why it’s a great buy: Compact design that doesn’t clutter your dashboard. Excellent choice for first-time buyers.

Best for: Everyday drivers who want a simple setup and reliable performance

Compatible with: iPhone (wired CarPlay cars only)

2. OTTOCAST Mini Cube 3.0: Best Premium Performance 

OTTOCAST has been a trusted name in this space for years and offers multiple versions. The Mini Cube 3.0 supports wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto via USB-C. It’s slightly more expensive, but you’ll notice the difference in day-to-day use. 

I liked its compact, sleek design that blends well with the car’s interior. Auto-connection takes only 5 seconds, audio is Hi-Fi quality, and switching between phones is smooth thanks to 5GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 4.2, and a next-gen chip.   

OTTOCAST also offers multiple versions, including a Magic CarPlay box that brings popular streaming apps like Netflix, YouTube, TikTok and Prime Video to your car’s screen. 

Why it’s a great buy: Very fast auto-connect (usually under 5 seconds). Great for a multi-device household.

Best for: Users who want top-tier speed and stability 

Compatible with: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto 

3. Carlinkit Wireless CarPlay Adapters: Best for Power Users & Tesla Owners 

Carlinkit offers a wide range of plug-and-play adapters and, in 2026, remains one of the most flexible brands on the market. Their Mini Ultra is perfect for regular cars, while the T2C Tesla adapter is specifically designed for Tesla vehicles that don’t support CarPlay natively. 

Performance is solid, with stable connections and decent app responsiveness. The best part is that Carlinkit adapters receive OTA firmware updates. You can continue to receive new features in the future. 

Why it’s a great buy: Good balance between flexibility, features, and price.  

Best for: Advanced users and Tesla drivers 

Compatible with: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto  

4. Car and Driver IntelliDash Pro X10: Best Built-In Display Option 

The IntelliDash Pro X10 is different from the others on this list. Instead of just being an adapter, it’s a standalone smart display that adds wireless CarPlay to almost any car, even older models.  

It mounts on your dashboard and connects to your iPhone or Android via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. So, you can access maps, calls, texts, Siri, music apps, and more. The large, bright touchscreen display is great for navigation, especially if your car’s original screen is small or outdated. 

Why it’s a great buy: Works even if your car has no CarPlay at all. Easy to move between vehicles. 

Best for: Cars without wired CarPlay or drivers who want a larger infotainment screen. 

Compatible with: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto 

5. Burnt Sugar Wireless CarPlay Ultra Mini: Best Budget Pick 

The Burnt Sugar Ultra Mini adapter is all about simplicity and size. Its USB-drive-like portable design is among the smallest on the market, making it ideal if you don’t want anything protruding from your dashboard. 

Despite its low price, performance is surprisingly good for basic tasks like navigation, music, and calls. You get 2.4+5.8GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.3 for fast connection and ultra-low latency.   

Why it’s a great buy: Extremely small and discreet in an affordable package. Perfect for casual users.   

Best for: Budget buyers and minimal setups 

Compatible with: Apple CarPlay 

How to Set Up Your Wireless CarPlay Adapter

It’s quite simple to set up a wireless CarPlay adapter. Most adapters come with instructions, but as a general guide, follow the steps below.

  1. Ensure your car supports wired Apple CarPlay. Then, check that your phone and car model are compatible with the adapter you’ve selected.
  2. Locate the USB or USB-C port in your car where you would plug in your iPhone for wired CarPlay. Plug your wireless car adapter into this port.
  3. Turn on your car’s infotainment system and wait for the adapter to power on.
  4. On your iPhone, go to Settings → Bluetooth and look for the adapter’s name in the available devices list.
  5. Tap on the adapter’s name to begin pairing.
  6. After Bluetooth pairing, the adapter may prompt you to connect to its WiFi network.
  7. Go to Settings → WiFi on your iPhone and select the network associated with the adapter. Enter the password if required (usually provided in the user manual).
  8. Once connected via Bluetooth and WiFi, your car’s infotainment screen should automatically switch to the CarPlay interface. If it doesn’t, manually select CarPlay from the infotainment system menu.

Now, try out the different CarPlay features, such as navigation, music, and hands-free calling, to check if they work.

Turn off and restart your car to confirm that the adapter automatically reconnects to your iPhone.

If you face issues, try these tips to fix CarPlay not working. Or contact the manufacturer of the wireless adapter for assistance.

Enjoy CarPlay with Wireless Convenience! 

Wireless CarPlay adapters are a small upgrade that makes a big difference in everyday driving. They eliminate the hassle of cables, connect automatically, and let you enjoy your favorite CarPlay apps without a wired connection. Consider your car model, budget, and driving frequency to buy the right one.  

Have you tried any CarPlay adapters before? Let me know your experience below!

  • Best Apple CarPlay head units
  • How to use SharePlay on Apple Music in your car

@graph.name: Jemluse Wireless CarPlay Adapter
@graph.description: The Jemluse Wireless CarPlay Adapter is one of the best-balanced options available in 2026. It’s small, lightweight, and made from aviation aluminum alloy, toughened glass, and high-density braids for durability. Moreover, the 5.8 GHz Wi-Fi, 5.3 Bluetooth, and 8-core processor provide a stable, low-lag connection for Apple Maps, Spotify, and phone calls.

@graph.name: OTTOCAST Mini Cube 3.0
@graph.description: OTTOCAST has been a trusted name in this space for years and offers multiple versions. The Mini Cube 3.0 supports wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto via USB-C. Auto-connection takes only 5 seconds, audio is Hi-Fi quality, and switching between phones is smooth thanks to 5GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 4.2, and a next-gen chip.

@graph.name: Carlinkit Mini Ultra Wireless CarPlay
@graph.description: Carlinkit offers a wide range of plug-and-play adapters and, in 2026, remains one of the most flexible brands on the market. Their Mini Ultra is perfect for regular cars, while the T2C Tesla adapter is specifically designed for Tesla vehicles that don’t support CarPlay natively.

@graph.name: Car and Driver IntelliDash Pro X10
@graph.description: Instead of just being an adapter, it’s a standalone smart display that adds wireless CarPlay to almost any car, even older models. It mounts on your dashboard and connects to your iPhone or Android via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. So, you can access maps, calls, texts, Siri, music apps, and more. The large, bright touchscreen display is great for navigation, especially if your car’s original screen is small or outdated.

@graph.name: Burnt Sugar Wireless CarPlay Ultra Mini
@graph.description: Its USB-drive-like portable design is among the smallest on the market, making it ideal if you don’t want anything protruding from your dashboard. Despite its low price, performance is surprisingly good for basic tasks like navigation, music, and calls. You get 2.4+5.8GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.3 for fast connection and ultra-low latency.
