title.rendered: 5 Best Apple Watch Chargers for Every Lifestyle in 2026

content.rendered:
Once you start using an Apple Watch, it becomes an integral part of your daily routine. It helps you track your workouts, manage notifications, and stay connected throughout the day, even when your iPhone isn’t around. But when the battery runs low, a reliable charger becomes essential.

While the charging puck you get in the box gets the job done pretty well, third-party options have evolved to offer faster charging, smarter designs, and even multi-device convenience. In this post, I’ve listed the top five third-party Apple Watch chargers that perfectly suit your desk setup and travel kit.

Table of Contents
  • How to Choose the Right Apple Watch Charger
  • 5 Best Apple Watch Chargers
    • 1. ￼Satechi Apple Watch Magnetic Charging Cable
    • 2. Belkin Portable USB-C Apple Watch Charger
    • 3. Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 Charger
    • 4. UGREEN MagFlow Qi2 3-in-1 Foldable Charger Stand
    • 5. Nomad Universal Charging Cable
  • Which Apple Watch Charger Should You Buy?

How to Choose the Right Apple Watch Charger

Before buying a new Apple Watch charger, it’s worth taking a few seconds to assess your lifestyle and charging habits. Third-party Apple Watch chargers come in several styles and configurations, and your ideal pick depends on how and where you plan to use it:

  • Charging speed: Look for fast-charging support when paired with a 20W or higher USB-C adapter.
  • Portability: Pick a compact or foldable design if you travel frequently.
  • Multi-device setup: Choose a multi-device charging station if you also need to charge your iPhone or AirPods simultaneously.
  • Certification: Always choose MFi-certified chargers for safe, efficient performance.
  • Build quality: Assess the cable’s sturdiness, the magnet’s stability, and the overall quality if you want long-term reliability.
  • Power source: Check if it includes a USB-C connector or requires a separate wall adapter.

5 Best Apple Watch Chargers

Now that you know the key points to keep in mind before buying an Apple Watch charger, here’s a comprehensive list of Apple Watch chargers that perfectly fit different routines, spaces, and charging needs:

1. Satechi Apple Watch Magnetic Charging Cable

The Satechi Apple Watch charging cable looks like a replica of Apple’s original, only smaller and more compact. You can use it with a wall adapter or directly with your MacBook, iPad, or even iPhone, making it a perfect choice for users who prefer a clean setup without bulky docks.

The braided cable resists tangles and fraying, while the magnetic puck aligns perfectly with your watch and supports fast charging.

2. Belkin Portable USB-C Apple Watch Charger

If you’re after portability, the Belkin BoostCharge Portable USB-C Charger is perfect. It even fits in your pocket. The charger features a no-cable design and plugs directly into your MacBook, iPad, or even iPhone.

It supports fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 and later models, charging your watch from 0 to 80% in about 45 minutes. All this makes it the ideal choice for travelers and users who need top-ups on the go.

3. Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 Charger

If you own multiple Apple devices, the Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 Charger is a space-saving powerhouse. It charges your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously in a modern, round design that looks great on any nightstand.

It’s MagSafe-compatible, ensuring perfect alignment for your iPhone, and provides steady magnetic charging for your Apple Watch. The best part: the charger folds into a UFO shape when not in use, helping reduce clutter.

4. UGREEN MagFlow Qi2 3-in-1 Foldable Charger Stand

The UGREEN MagFlow Qi2 3-in-1 Foldable Charger Station is an excellent all-in-one option for those who want value and flexibility. It supports Qi2 fast charging and powers your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously.

Its foldable design makes it perfect for travel, and UGREEN’s built-in safety protections prevent overheating and overcurrent. This charger strikes the right balance between performance and portability.

5. Nomad Universal Charging Cable

The Nomad Universal Charging Cable combines versatility with craftsmanship. It’s a braided USB-C cable with an integrated Apple Watch magnetic puck, letting you charge both your watch and other devices from a single cable.

The 100W Power Delivery support allows it to handle everything from your Apple Watch to your MacBook. The high-quality materials make it ideal for travelers or minimalists who want one cable for all their devices.

Which Apple Watch Charger Should You Buy?

Here’s which of the listed options you should choose and why:

  • If you want a simple, no-fuss charger, go for Belkin’s portable charger or Satechi magnetic charging cable.
  • If you prefer a single station for all your devices, the Anker UFO and UGREEN MagFlow are unbeatable.
  • Frequent travelers should consider Belkin’s portable charger for its no-cable design and pocket-friendly build.
  • For users who prefer a minimal design, Satechi’s magnetic charging cable offers unmatched simplicity.
  • And for design enthusiasts, Nomad’s Base Station adds a premium touch to your setup.

The Apple Watch is designed to help you stay connected throughout the day, but to do so, it needs a reliable charger that can recharge it quickly. Since the Apple Watch launch back in 2015, its charging ecosystem has evolved far beyond the basic magnetic puck. You can choose one that supports fast charging, is portable for travel, or is an all-in-one solution for all your Apple gadgets.

Always invest in a reliable, MFi-certified charger from brands like Satechi, Belkin, Anker, UGREEN, and Nomad, and your Apple Watch will always be ready for your next run, meeting, or night out.

Got a charger you swear by? Drop your recommendation in the comments below.

  • Best Apple Watch bands
  • Apple Watch won’t turn on? 8 Fixes
  • How to Delete Workouts on Apple Watch

mainEntity.name: Do AirTags interfere with credit cards?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. AirTags use Bluetooth and Ultra-Wideband signals that operate on completely different frequencies than credit card chips or their magnetic strips. Apple designed them to be safe next to cards. Just ensure the AirTag isn’t pressing too hard on the card’s surface to prevent physical wear.

@graph.name: Satechi Apple Watch Magnetic Charging Cable
@graph.description: The Satechi Apple Watch charging cable looks like a replica of Apple’s original, only smaller and more compact. You can use it with a wall adapter or directly with your MacBook, iPad, or even iPhone, making it a perfect choice for users who prefer a clean setup without bulky docks.

@graph.name: Belkin Portable USB-C Apple Watch Charger
@graph.description: If you’re after portability, the Belkin BoostCharge Portable USB-C Charger is perfect. It even fits in your pocket. The charger features a no-cable design and plugs directly into your MacBook, iPad, or even iPhone.

@graph.name: Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 Charger
@graph.description: If you own multiple Apple devices, the Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 Charger is a space-saving powerhouse. It charges your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously in a modern, round design that looks great on any nightstand.

@graph.name: UGREEN MagFlow Qi2 3-in-1 Foldable Charger Stand
@graph.description: The UGREEN MagFlow Qi2 3-in-1 Foldable Charger Station is an excellent all-in-one option for those who want value and flexibility. It supports Qi2 fast charging and powers your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously.

@graph.name: Nomad Universal Charging Cable
@graph.description: The Nomad Universal Charging Cable combines versatility with craftsmanship. It’s a braided USB-C cable with an integrated Apple Watch magnetic puck, letting you charge both your watch and other devices from a single cable.

title.rendered: Best AirPods Cleaning Kits for 2026: Deep-Clean Your Buds & Case

content.rendered:
Keeping your AirPods sounding crisp isn’t just about the latest audio upgrades; it’s about properly maintaining them. Dust, earwax, and pocket lint can quietly ruin sound quality, shorten battery life, and even affect comfort. That’s why a good AirPods cleaning kit has become essential. 

In this guide, we’ve rounded up the best cleaning kits. Easy to use, safe for your device, and extremely effective, they will get your AirPods running again in minutes.

Table of Contents
  • What to Consider When Buying the Right AirPods Cleaning Kit
  • Top 5 AirPods Cleaning Tools & Kits
    • 1. Hagibis Cleaning Pen Multi‑Function Kit
    • 2. KeyBudz Air Care Cleaning Kit
    • 3. Ordilend Portable Cleaning Kit
    • 4. Belkin AirPods Cleaning Kit
    • 5. walrfid 20‑in‑1 Cleaning Kit
  • How to Clean Your AirPods Safely Using a Cleaning Kit
  • Keep Your AirPods Pristine!

What to Consider When Buying the Right AirPods Cleaning Kit

Choosing the right cleaning kit is all about safety, compatibility, and convenience. Here’s what to look for:

  • Compatibility: This ensures the tools are safe for your AirPods, mesh, grills, and charging case. Different models have delicate parts.
  • Tools Included: Look for essentials such as a soft brush, a cleaning pen, a microfiber cloth, and a safe cleaning solution. The kit should cover both earbuds and the case.
  • Safety: Avoid anything abrasive. The kit should be designed specifically for AirPods.
  • Effectiveness: It should be able to reach into small crevices, such as speaker mesh, charging ports, and inner-case corners.
  • Ease of Use: Simple tools, clear instructions, and reusable materials make frequent cleaning easy.
  • Price vs. Value: Choose a kit that makes a good balance between quality and price. Very expensive bundles are unnecessary unless they justify the price by adding value.

Top 5 AirPods Cleaning Tools & Kits

Here I have listed the best 5 cleaning kits that can help you clean the AirPods, the charging case, and ports safely. 

1. Hagibis Cleaning Pen Multi‑Function Kit

Hagibis cleaning tool has a clever three-in-one design: a soft flocking sponge for the charging case, a high-density brush for speaker holes, and a slim metal tip for crevices. So, you won’t need separate tools.  

Moreover, its compact pen-style format is easy to carry and use anytime. However, no sprays or liquids are included.  Therefore, it’s ideal only for cleaning dust and earwax. On the flip side, if you’re after deep sanitising, you’ll need to look further. 

Best for: Hagibis Cleaner Pen is lightweight, affordable, travel-friendly, and effective for the basics.

2. KeyBudz Air Care Cleaning Kit

Want to keep your earbuds and their case spotless like new? The KeyBudz Air Care Cleaning Kit is a solid, no-fuss option. Built for models like Apple AirPods and AirPods Pro, it focuses on deep-down cleaning and hygiene. 

You’ll get sticky putty pieces that lift out grime from speaker meshes and inner case corners. Then there’s a tool called UtilityStik with a precision metal tip, a bristle brush, and a microfiber swab. These loosen wax and residue. Finally, the disinfecting wet wipes and swabs focus on cleaning the exterior.  

Best for: If you use your AirPods or AirPods Pro regularly, the KeyBudz cleaning kit offers all-around maintenance on a budget.

3. Ordilend Portable Cleaning Kit

If you’re dealing with annoying charging woes, this Ordilend kit is built for that same problem space. The kit brings together a small multi-tool set designed to clean and maintain charging ports, Lightning connectors, earphone jacks and speaker meshes.  

All the tools are made from high-quality, sturdy ABS plastic. Additionally, the compact case design lets you carry the kit with you on the go. Along with the cleaning tools, you’ll get a cleaning putty and a microfiber cloth. If you use Lightning cables, this kit is a must-have. 

Best for: The Ordilend cleaning kit plays a valuable role as the port/connector specialist, along with AirPods cleaning. 

4. Belkin AirPods Cleaning Kit

The Belkin AirPods Cleaning Kit is a simple, purpose-built solution to keep your earbuds fresh, hygienic, and sounding clear. This kit comprises a gentle cleaning gel, wax softener, a precision brush, and a soft microfiber cloth. You’ll be able to clean earwax, dust, and grime without damaging fragile speaker meshes or charging contacts. 

Unlike DIY cleaning hacks, this kit is designed specifically for AirPods, ensuring safe use and reliable results. Moreover, Belkin has provided a step-by-step process in the kit package, so you’ll have no issues with cleaning. However, it’s not the cheapest option, and best for one or two deep cleans. 

Best for: If you want brand assurance and don’t mind spending on a one-time solution, go for the Belkin AirPods cleaning kit. 

5. walrfid 20‑in‑1 Cleaning Kit

If your workspace gadgets (earbuds, keyboards, charging cases, screens) start looking grimy, this walrfid 20-in-1 kit lets you clean everything in one go. It comes with a variety of tools, including a flocked sponge, a small brush, a lens/port cleaning pen, and other attachments.  

With so many delicate tools, you can easily tackle dust, lint, smudges and buildup on keyboards, earbuds, screens and cases. However, if you’re only focused on cleaning the earbuds, a more focused kit might suffice and be simpler. 

Best for: This Walrfid 20-in-1 kit offers the broadest coverage and more specialised cleaning options.

How to Clean Your AirPods Safely Using a Cleaning Kit

With the right cleaning kit, you can easily make your AirPods spotless and improve sound quality. Here’s a simple, safe process to follow, whether you’re using the Belkin, Hagibis, Ordilend, warlfid, or KeyBudz cleaning kits from our list. 

  1. Wipe off any visible dust with a dry microfiber cloth.
  2. Use a soft brush from the kit to gently loosen debris around the speaker mesh.
  3. If your kit includes cleaning putty or sticky pads, press them lightly over the mesh to lift out stubborn wax or lint.
  4. Use the flocked sponge to clean the inside of the charging slots and hinge area.
  5. Gently clean out dust or lint from the Lightning or USB-C port with a metal or plastic cleaning pen.

Make cleaning AirPods a monthly ritual. A 5-minute clean keeps them looking new, ensures clear sound, and prevents charging issues. You can also use AirPods case covers for more protection. 

Keep Your AirPods Pristine! 

That’s all! A good AirPods cleaning kit helps prevent muffled sound, poor charging, and bacteria buildup that come with daily use. A quick clean takes only a few minutes but makes a huge difference in sound clarity and comfort. 

Whether you choose a premium kit like Belkin, a compact tool like Hagibis, or an all-in-one option like walrfid, they keep your earbuds fresh and functioning like new. 

Do you use any other tools to clean your AirPods? Let me know in the comments below!

title.rendered: How to Zip and Unzip Files and Folders on Mac

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What zipping does on a Mac: Compressing files into a .zip archive reduces their size and groups them together for easier sharing and storage, without losing any data.
  • Why creating ZIP files is useful: Zipping helps save disk space, speeds up file transfers, keeps content organized, and maintains folder hierarchy during sharing.
  • How to zip and unzip using Finder: Right-click files or folders in Finder and select Compress to create a ZIP file; double-click any ZIP to extract its contents.
  • Using Terminal for advanced control: Run commands like zip -r to create archives or unzip to extract them, offering more customization and automation options.
  • Creating password-protected ZIP files: Use the Terminal command zip -er to encrypt archives with a password, securing sensitive data during transfers.

Zipping and unzipping files is one of those simple yet essential tasks that both beginner and seasoned Mac users should know how to do. It helps you organize projects, share multiple files in one package, and save valuable storage space.

The good part is that you don’t need any complicated third-party apps, as your Mac has everything you need. From Finder to Archive Utility to Terminal, there are several quick and reliable ways to manage ZIP files on a Mac. This post details how to zip and unzip files and folders on your Mac.

Table of Contents
  • What Does Zipping a File or Folder Do on a Mac?
  • Benefits of Creating Zip Files or Folders on Your Mac
  • How to Zip and Unzip Files on a Mac Using Finder
    • Zip Files Using Finder:
    • Unzip Files Using Finder:
  • How to Zip and Unzip Files Using Terminal
    • Zip Files Using Terminal:
    • Unzip Files Using Terminal:
  • How to Create a Password-Protected ZIP File
  • How to Zip and Unzip Files Using Archive Utility
    • Zip Files Using Archive Utility:
    • Unzip Files Using Archive Utility:
  • Your Mac, Your Workflow…

What Does Zipping a File or Folder Do on a Mac?

When you zip a file or folder on a Mac, macOS compresses its contents into a single archive with the .zip extension. This process reduces the overall file size and bundles multiple items into one package for easier sharing or storage.

The compressed file contains all the original data, but in a more efficient format. When you unzip it, macOS restores the files exactly as they were, without any loss of quality or structure.

Zipping is handled automatically by the built-in Archive Utility, which uses standard ZIP compression that’s fully compatible with Windows, Linux, and other operating systems.

Benefits of Creating Zip Files or Folders on Your Mac

Zipping files on your Mac has several practical advantages:

  • Saves storage space: You get more disk space or can store more files on external drives, as compression reduces file size.
  • Simplifies sharing: Sending one ZIP file is faster and easier than sending multiple attachments or folders.
  • Keeps files organized: You can package related documents, images, or projects together for easy access later.
  • Speeds up uploads and backups: Smaller archives transfer faster to cloud services like iCloud Drive, Google Drive, or Dropbox.
  • Preserves structure: Zipping keeps the folder hierarchy intact, so everything stays organized when the recipient unzips it.

How to Zip and Unzip Files on a Mac Using Finder

The Finder offers the fastest and easiest way to zip and unzip files on a Mac without involving any technical steps. Here’s how:

Zip Files Using Finder:

  1. Open Finder and head to the folder containing the file or subfolder you want to compress.
  2. Now, Control-click the item and select Compress [File Name] or Compress if you’ve selected multiple files in the drop-down menu.
  3. Once done, macOS will create a new .zip file in the same location.

Your original file or folder remains untouched; you can keep or delete it if you want. The created .zip file has the same name as your original file. You can rename it later if you want.

Note If you select multiple files, macOS names the new archive “Archive.zip” by default.

Unzip Files Using Finder:

Unzipping files or folders on a Mac is as easy as zipping them. Here’s how:

  1. Locate the .zip file or folder you want to unzip, then double-click it.
  2. Once done, macOS will extract the contents into a new folder next to the original archive.

How to Zip and Unzip Files Using Terminal

For users who prefer precision and flexibility, macOS includes Terminal commands that give more control over how files are zipped and unzipped.

Zip Files Using Terminal:

  1. Open Terminal.
  2. Here, type in “cd” and drag & drop the folder that contains the file or subfolder you want to compress in the Terminal window and hit Return. This ensures you’re in the right directory before compressing.
  3. Now enter the following Terminal command code: zip -r ArchiveName.zip FolderName
    • Replace ArchiveName with the name you want for the ZIP file.
    • Replace FolderName with the exact name of the folder (case-sensitive).
  4. Press Return, and the Terminal will create the ZIP file or folder in your current directory.

Unzip Files Using Terminal:

  1. Open Terminal, type in “cd“, enter the folder path, and hit Return.
  2. Now, enter the command: unzip ArchiveName.zip
  3. Press the Return key.

The unzipped file will appear in the same directory; just ensure the original file is no longer there. Otherwise, the “replace Images/.DS_Store? [y]es, [n]o, [A]ll, [N]one, [r]ename:” prompt will appear asking whether you want to:

  • Overwrite any existing file.
  • Extract, but do not overwrite existing files.
  • Overwrite all existing files automatically without asking again.
  • Skip all existing files, leaving them unchanged.
  • Rename the extracted file to prevent overwriting the existing one.

How to Create a Password-Protected ZIP File

While Finder offers the fastest way to zip files, it cannot create encrypted ZIP archives. That’s where Terminal proves most useful, as it lets you create encrypted ZIP archives. Here’s how:

  1. Open Terminal, type in “cd“, enter the folder path and hit Return.
  2. Now enter the command: zip -er ProtectedFolder.zip FolderName
  3. Replace SecureArchive with the name you want for the password-protected ZIP file.
  4. Replace FolderName with the exact name of the folder (case-sensitive).
  5. Press Return.
  6. Enter the desired password, then press Return.

How to Zip and Unzip Files Using Archive Utility

Archive Utility is the built-in macOS tool that handles all compression and extraction tasks. It works quietly in the background whenever you create or open ZIP files using Finder. You can also use it directly, although it doesn’t have a visible interface.

Zip Files Using Archive Utility:

  1. Open Archive Utility on your Mac. The app will appear in your Dock but won’t display a window.
  2. Now, simply drag and drop the file or folder you want to compress onto its Dock icon.
  3. A ZIP file is instantly created in the same folder as the original item.

Unzip Files Using Archive Utility:

The fastest way to unzip a file on a Mac is still by double-clicking it. But, if you want to do so via Archive Utility, all you need to do is drag and drop the Zip file onto its Dock icon, and the app automatically expands the file into the same folder.

Your Mac, Your Workflow…

Now you know how straightforward it is to zip and unzip files on a Mac. In addition to the methods mentioned earlier, you can use third-party apps such as Keka or The Unarchiver to compress files and save them more effectively.

Have you tried using Terminal or Archive Utility for file compression? Tell us which method works best for you in the comments below.

title.rendered: Google Photos Expands AI Editing to iPhone With ‘Help Me Edit’ and Global ‘Ask Photos’

content.rendered:
Google is enhancing its Photos app with AI tools now available on iOS, including the interactive ‘Help Me Edit’ feature and the worldwide introduction of ‘Ask Photos.’ Originally, these updates aim to make personalizing photo edits more intuitive across platforms.

‘Help Me Edit’ Lands on iOS With Customized AI Capabilities

Following its Android introduction, the conversational editing tool ‘Help Me Edit’ is now live for iPhone and iPad users in the United States. Within the Photos app, users will find a revamped editor featuring a text field called “Help me edit” at the bottom when they tap Edit on a photo. This feature simplifies multi-step editing by allowing users to describe desired changes in ordinary language.

For instance, you can type phrases like, “Remove the glare from the glasses, brighten the sky, and make everyone smile.” The AI processes these instructions and applies the edits automatically. According to Google, this tech can even use private face groups to refine results, like adjusting expressions in group photos.

Additionally, the update introduces the Nano Banana model, which facilitates artistic edits. This model supports imaginative requests such as “make this look like a watercolor painting” or “turn it into a comic book cover.” A new Create with AI carousel in the Create tab offers ready-made prompts like “turn me into a magazine cover” or “create a holiday portrait.” The update begins its rollout in the US and India for Android next week, with iOS soon to follow.

‘Ask Photos’ Rolls Out to Over 100 Countries in 17 Languages

Initially launched in the US earlier this year, ‘Ask Photos’—Google Photos’ AI-driven search tool—is now expanding globally. The introduction of the Ask tab replaces the old Search tab, enabling users to perform natural language searches such as, “Show me pictures of my cat playing in the garden” or “Find my graduation photos.”

With enhanced context understanding, ‘Ask Photos‘ retrieves relevant images quickly, eliminating the need for manual scrolling. Google confirms that the tool is reaching more than 100 countries and will support 17 languages.

A new Ask button is also part of the update, available directly while viewing any image. Positioned between “Edit” and “Add to,” this button is marked with a Gemini icon. Clicking it provides an instant description of the photo and opens a conversation box for follow-up questions or editing requests.

Introducing Smarter AI Templates Soon

In the coming weeks, Google plans to deploy personalized AI templates that draw from insights about user habits or preferences based on their photo history, such as favorite pastimes. This feature could enable users to request, “Make a sketch of me hiking” or “Create a cartoon of me and my pet,” paving the way for more customized edits.

Google Photos is shifting from a simple storage solution to a dynamic AI assistant capable of arranging, understanding, and editing images through straightforward dialogue.

Are these changes important to you? Tell us what you think!

mainEntity.name: Do AirTags interfere with credit cards?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. AirTags use Bluetooth and Ultra-Wideband signals that operate on completely different frequencies than credit card chips or their magnetic strips. Apple designed them to be safe next to cards. Just ensure the AirTag isn’t pressing too hard on the card’s surface to prevent physical wear.

title.rendered: Apple Delays iPhone Air 2, Targets 2027 Redesign

content.rendered:
Apple is reportedly postponing the iPhone Air 2 launch, aiming for a major redesign to win over consumers. According to a report from The Information, Apple has informed its engineers and partners that the next iPhone Air is off the production schedule without a set release date.

Apple Halts iPhone Air 2 Development

Originally set for a fall 2026 debut alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and the rumored iPhone Fold, the iPhone Air 2 has been removed from Apple’s schedule altogether, based on insights shared by The Information. However, it’s not completely shelved. Engineers and some manufacturing partners are said to continue their work behind the scenes.

The delay seems to stem from Apple’s decision to overhaul the iPhone Air 2 to enhance its appeal after disappointing sales of the first-generation model. Plans for the redesign reportedly include the addition of a second rear camera, a feature users felt was lacking in the original iPhone Air.

Revamp Eyes Spring 2027 Release

There are hopes among Apple engineers that the revamped iPhone Air 2 could launch in spring 2027, possibly alongside the base iPhone 18 and the budget-friendly iPhone 18e. Yet, the timeline remains uncertain, leaving some speculation in its wake.

Initially, Apple envisioned the iPhone Air 2 as a lighter version with an increased battery capacity and a vapor chamber cooling system, a feature initially introduced in the iPhone 17 Pro. These planned enhancements were meant to boost performance while maintaining the slim and lightweight profile that marked the original iPhone Air.

Production Slows Amid Lackluster Demand

As reported by The Information, Apple’s manufacturing allies, Foxconn and Luxshare, have already cut back production of the current iPhone Air due to tepid demand. Foxconn has dismantled most of its production setups, with assembly expected to cease by November. Luxshare already stopped production in October.

This strategic pivot echoes Apple’s past responses to underwhelming sales of models like the iPhone mini and iPhone Plus, suggesting a wider pattern of adjusting strategies based on market demand.

Uncommon Choice for Apple’s iPhone Roadmap

Apple’s decision to pull a product from its launch plans after entering production is decidedly rare, marking this as a noteworthy deviation. The move implies a strategic pullback as Apple reassesses its iPhone lineup expansion, prioritizing the refinement of the Air series before committing to further releases.

If this plan prevails, Apple’s 2026 lineup will likely consist of just three models: the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Fold, with the refreshed iPhone Air 2 arriving in 2027.

Would a redesigned iPhone Air 2 matter to you? Share your thoughts below.

title.rendered: Apple Introduces Limited Edition iPhone Pocket with Issey Miyake

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple debuts the limited-edition iPhone Pocket: Created with the Issey Miyake studio, this rare accessory blends art and utility in a minimalist design.
  • Fashion meets functionality in a 3D-knit design: The iPhone Pocket uses stretchable fabric to hold an iPhone and small essentials, worn crossbody, over the shoulder, or around the wrist.
  • Two strap versions with vibrant color options: Available in short strap ($149.95) and long strap ($229.95) models, offering users flexible styling choices.
  • Apple’s first direct-to-retail limited edition release: Marks a shift in Apple’s retail strategy, making exclusive collaborations available directly through Apple Stores.
  • Global launch with limited availability: The iPhone Pocket arrives this Friday in select regions including the US, UK, France, China, Italy, Japan, Singapore, and South Korea.

Apple has introduced a new limited edition accessory for the iPhone called the iPhone Pocket, marking one of the few times the company has described a product as a limited release.

Designed in collaboration with the Issey Miyake design studio, known for crafting Steve Jobs’ famous black turtleneck, the iPhone Pocket reimagines the charm of the 2004 iPod Socks in a modern, fashion-forward form. The accessory uses a single 3D-knitted stretchable cloth to create a sleek, wearable pocket that can hold an iPhone along with other small items.

The iPhone Pocket can be worn in multiple ways, such as over the shoulder, around the wrist, or attached to a handbag. The fabric stretches enough to let users peek at the iPhone’s screen without fully removing it.

Apple is offering the iPhone Pocket in two versions:

  • Short strap version priced at $149.95, available in lemon, mandarin, purple, pink, peacock, sapphire, cinnamon, and black.
  • Long strap version priced at $229.95, available in sapphire, cinnamon, and black.

This launch appears to be the first limited edition accessory ever sold directly through Apple’s retail stores. In the past, Apple has offered seasonal or brand collaborations such as Hermès Apple Watch bands, but these were never marketed as limited-time releases.

Availability

The iPhone Pocket will be available this Friday in select regions, including the US, UK, France, China, Italy, Japan, Singapore, and South Korea. It will also be displayed in a small number of Apple Stores.

With the iPhone Pocket, Apple is once again merging fashion and technology, offering a collectible piece that reflects both style and innovation.

What do you think of Apple’s new iPhone Pocket design? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

excerpt.rendered: Apple has introduced the iPhone Pocket, a limited edition 3D-knitted accessory made with Issey Miyake’s design team. It’s a stylish, flexible pocket for your iPhone that comes in multiple colors and strap options.

mainEntity.name: Do AirTags interfere with credit cards?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. AirTags use Bluetooth and Ultra-Wideband signals that operate on completely different frequencies than credit card chips or their magnetic strips. Apple designed them to be safe next to cards. Just ensure the AirTag isn’t pressing too hard on the card’s surface to prevent physical wear.

keyPoints.title: Apple Introduces Limited Edition iPhone Pocket
keyPoints.explanation: Apple has launched a new, limited-edition accessory called the iPhone Pocket, designed in collaboration with the Issey Miyake studio, emphasizing its rarity and unique appeal.

keyPoints.title: Design Inspired by Fashion and Functionality
keyPoints.explanation: The iPhone Pocket features a sleek, 3D-knitted stretchable fabric capable of holding an iPhone and small items, worn in various ways such as over the shoulder or around the wrist.

keyPoints.title: Multiple Versions and Price Points**
keyPoints.explanation: Available in short strap ($149.95) and long strap ($229.95) versions, the accessory comes in various vibrant colors, offering flexibility and style options for users.

keyPoints.title: First Direct-to-Retail Limited Edition Accessory**
keyPoints.explanation: This marks the first time Apple has sold a limited-edition accessory directly through its retail stores, setting a new precedent for exclusive product releases.

keyPoints.title: Availability and Regions**
keyPoints.explanation: The iPhone Pocket will launch this Friday in select regions including the US, UK, France, China, Italy, Japan, Singapore, and South Korea, with a limited presence in Apple Stores.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: 10 Adorable and Cute Stitch Wallpapers for iPhone in 4K Quality

content.rendered:
We all may agree that Lilo & Stitch is pure nostalgia. Whether you love his adorable chaos, his big blue eyes, or just want something fun and cheerful on your screen, Stitch wallpaper is perfect.

Here are 10 cute Stitch wallpapers that will instantly level up your iPhone Lock Screen’s cuteness. Explore each one, then tap the Download button below to save it for free on your iPhone in 4K quality.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Cute & Playful Stitch Warning
    • 2. Shred Snitvh
  • 2. Sleepy Stitch on Cloudy Sky
  • 3. Peekaboo Stitch Wallpaper
  • 4. Excited Furry Stitch
  • 5. Easter Egg Stitch Wallpaper
  • 6. Stitch as a Halloween Ghost
  • 7. Valentine’s Day Stitch Love Wallpaper
  • 8. Stitch & Angel in a Frame
  • 9. Lilo & Stitch Summer Vibes
  • 10. Christmas Stitch Holiday Wallpaper

1. Cute & Playful Stitch Warning

This minimalist wallpaper features Stitch giving a cheeky wink with his tongue out. A fun message appears below him, adding a bit of humor to your screen. The clean, white background keeps it subtle while allowing Stitch’s personality to shine through.

Download

2. Sleepy Stitch on Cloudy Sky

A sleepy Stitch is lying on your app bar on the Home Screen as if he’s drifting into dreamland. The blue sky and fluffy clouds create a calm, cozy vibe. Download the wallpaper from iPinimg if you want something cute and relaxing for your iPhone.

Download

If you’re loving the Stitch wallpaper, also check out cute Snoopy wallpapers for iPhone that will instantly boost your mood.

3. Peekaboo Stitch Wallpaper

This wallpaper from Wallpaper Clan shows a close-up of Stitch adorably peeking in from the side of the screen. With a soft blue background and his big expressive eye, it creates a playful look. It also works well as a Depth Effect wallpaper.

Download

4. Excited Furry Stitch

Another minimal wallpaper with a fluffy version of Stitch popping up from the side with a huge, excited grin. His bright eyes and soft fur texture make the image feel lively and full of personality. Thanks to Wall Space for creating this beautiful wallpaper.

Download

5. Easter Egg Stitch Wallpaper

This wallpaper from Wallpapers.com features a cute, tiny Stitch surrounded by colorful Easter eggs in different patterns like clouds, hearts, flowers, and stripes. It’s perfect for anyone who loves Stitch and wants a fun holiday-themed wallpaper for their phone.

Download

Check out: Best Easter Wallpapers for iPhone

6. Stitch as a Halloween Ghost

Stitch is known for his cute chaos, so dressing up like a ghost for Halloween is a perfect match. Surrounded by bats, pumpkins, spiders, and spooky doodles, the wallpaper has a fun and festive Halloween vibe.

Download

7. Valentine’s Day Stitch Love Wallpaper

Stitch pops up on this @Disney wallpaper in an adorable hand-drawn form, holding a pink heart and smiling. The soft pastel doodles, hearts, and message add so much sweetness and romance. Save to get the cutest, love-filled wallpaper on your phone.

Download

Also read: Cute Valentine’s Day wallpapers for iPhone

8. Stitch & Angel in a Frame

Remember Angel, Stitch’s cute lover? This bright-colored split design wallpaper features Stitch on one side and Angel on the other, creating a fun contrast in bold pink and blue.

Download

9. Lilo & Stitch Summer Vibes

The list of Stitch wallpaper would not be complete without Lilo. Here’s a wallpaper showing Lilo and Stitch enjoying a fun summer moment together. Both of them are wearing cool sunglasses and holding colorful shaved ice, giving off a vacation vibe.

Download

10. Christmas Stitch Holiday Wallpaper

This wallpaper features cute Stitch wearing a Santa hat, looking cheerful and festive. The background is decorated with holiday goodies like gingerbread cookies, cupcakes, stars, and holly, giving it a fun Christmas look.

Download

Cuteness Overloaded with Stitch Wallpaper!

And there you have it! 10 super-cute Stitch wallpapers that add a little extra joy and personality to your iPhone. Whether you love fun designs, seasonal themes, or just can’t get enough of Stitch’s adorable expressions, there is something here for every mood. 

Feel free to download your favorites, switch them up whenever you like, and keep your screen looking as cute as possible. Also, let us know which iPhone wallpaper collection you want next!

title.rendered: How to Remotely Wipe a Lost Mac

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Prerequisites for Wiping Your Mac: You need Find My Mac turned on, your Mac online, and locked to your Apple ID to erase it remotely.
  • Wiping Your Mac from an iPhone or iPad: Open the Find My app, pick your Mac, choose Erase This Device, add a recovery message, and confirm with your Apple ID.
  • Wiping Your Mac using Another Mac: Open Find My on another Mac signed in with the same iCloud account, select the lost device, and confirm erasure with a passcode.
  • Wiping Your Mac via iCloud.com: Sign in to iCloud.com, select your Mac under Find Devices, and click Erase Mac to wipe it from any browser or platform.
  • After You Erase Your Mac: The Mac locks itself, deletes all data, shows your recovery message, and remains protected by Activation Lock to block unauthorized use.

If you’ve ever forgotten your Mac in a café or had someone snatch your bag, your first thought probably isn’t about the price. It’s about what’s inside: your photos, saved passwords, files, and maybe even your payment details. That’s exactly why Apple built Find My Mac, a built-in feature that gives you one last line of defense. You can lock your Mac, locate it, and if things go wrong, erase it remotely before anyone can access your data.

This guide walks you through everything you should know before wiping your Mac remotely, plus step-by-step methods to erase it using an iPhone or iPad, another Mac, or any web browser through iCloud.

Table of Contents
  • What You Should Know Before Wiping Your Mac
  • Option 1: Wipe Your Mac Remotely Using an iPhone or iPad
  • Option 2: Wipe Your Mac Using Another Mac
  • Option 3: Wipe Your Mac Using iCloud on Any Device
  • What Happens After You Wipe Your Mac
  • If You Didn't Set Up Find My Mac
  • Final Tip

What You Should Know Before Wiping Your Mac

Before you send the erase command, make sure you understand these key points:

  • Find My Mac must be enabled before your Mac went missing. Without it, you can’t track or wipe your device.
  • The Mac must be turned on and connected to the internet for the erase command to take effect.
  • Once you erase your Mac, it’s permanently removed from Find My, and you won’t be able to track it afterward.
  • Even if it’s erased, it will stay locked to your Apple ID. That means no one can reactivate or use it without your password.

If you didn’t set up Find My Mac, skip to the end, there are few workarounds that can help you protect your data.

Option 1: Wipe Your Mac Remotely Using an iPhone or iPad

If you have another Apple device signed in with the same Apple ID, this is the easiest method. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Find My app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Go to the Devices tab at the bottom.
  3. From the list of devices, tap your missing Mac.
  4. You’ll see its last known location on a map. If it’s nearby, tap Play Sound to locate it.
  5. If you’re sure you can’t recover it, scroll down and tap Erase This Device.
  6. Tap Continue, then enter a short recovery message. For example, “This Mac is lost. Please contact me at [your number].” Avoid sharing personal details like your address.
  7. Tap Erase, then enter your Apple ID password to confirm.

Once the command is sent, the Mac will erase itself the next time it connects to the internet. You’ll get a notification when the process begins.

Option 2: Wipe Your Mac Using Another Mac

If you own a second Mac linked to the same iCloud account, you can use the desktop version of Find My:

  1. Open the Find My app on your other Mac.
  2. Click the Devices tab.
  3. From the list, select the Mac you want to erase.
  4. Click the info (i) button next to it.
  5. Choose Erase This Device, then click Continue.

  6. If asked, enter a six-digit passcode, this locks the Mac until it’s erased.
  7. Add a recovery message, such as a contact number, then select Erase.
  8. Enter your Apple ID password to confirm.

If the lost Mac is offline, the command will queue and execute as soon as it’s back online.

Option 3: Wipe Your Mac Using iCloud on Any Device

If you don’t have another Apple device, you can still wipe your Mac from any web browser, even on a Windows PC or Android phone.

  1. Go to iCloud.com/find and sign in with your Apple ID.
  2. Click All Devices at the top.
  3. Select your Mac from the list.
  4. Click Erase Mac.
  5. Confirm the action when prompted.
  6. Enter your Apple ID password again for verification.
  7. Type in a six-digit passcode to lock the Mac.
  8. Add a recovery message that shows on the lock screen.

Your Mac will erase itself as soon as it connects to the internet. You’ll see its status update in iCloud when the wipe begins.

What Happens After You Wipe Your Mac

Once the erase command goes through, your Mac will:

  • Lock itself automatically.
  • Delete all data, settings, and files.
  • Display your recovery message on screen.

If the thief or finder tries to use it, they’ll hit the Activation Lock, which requires your Apple ID credentials to set up the Mac again. So even if they erase it locally, it’s still useless to them.

If You Didn’t Set Up Find My Mac

If you never turned on Find My Mac, you can’t track or erase it remotely, but you can still secure your data.

  • Change your Apple ID password immediately to block access to iCloud, iMessage, and Apple services.
  • Update passwords for your email, banking, and social media accounts.
  • Report your Mac’s serial number to local law enforcement. You can find it on your Mac’s box, invoice, or purchase receipt.

If you find your Mac later, take it to an Apple Authorized Service Provider with proof of purchase to unlock it.

Final Tip

If you’ve ever experienced that sinking feeling of a missing Mac, you know how helpless it feels. Setting up Find My Mac is a small step that makes a big difference, it’s like having a built-in insurance policy for your data. You can’t always prevent your Mac from going missing, but you can make sure your personal life doesn’t go with it.

Read more:

  • How to remotely erase data from lost iPhone and iPad
  • How to use Tab Groups in Safari on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
  • Mouse cursor disappears on Mac? 13 Working fixes

keyPoints.title: Prerequisites for Wiping Your Mac
keyPoints.explanation: You need Find My Mac enabled, your Mac turned on, connected to the internet, and locked to your Apple ID to remotely wipe it.

keyPoints.title: Wiping Your Mac with an iPhone or iPad
keyPoints.explanation: Use the Find My app on your Apple device to locate, lock, or erase your Mac remotely by following simple steps like entering a recovery message and your Apple ID password.

keyPoints.title: Wiping Your Mac using Another Mac
keyPoints.explanation: Access Find My on another Mac linked to the same iCloud account, select your lost Mac, and choose 'Erase This Device' after entering a recovery passcode.

keyPoints.title: Wiping Your Mac via iCloud on Any Device
keyPoints.explanation: Visit iCloud.com, sign in, select your device, and click 'Erase Mac' to remotely wipe it through any web browser, even on non-Apple devices.

keyPoints.title: What Happens After Wiping Your Mac
keyPoints.explanation: The Mac automatically locks, deletes all data, and displays a recovery message; Activation Lock then protects it from unauthorized use.

title.rendered: iOS 27 Expected to Feature Three Key AI Additions

content.rendered:
Apple seems poised to introduce three substantial AI features in iOS 27, signaling a notable progression in its Apple Intelligence roadmap. This information originates from Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, who elaborated on the upcoming additions in his latest Power On newsletter.

Apple Intelligence to See Advances in Siri, Web, and Health AI

Gurman reports that iOS 27 will feature:

  • A completely revamped Siri with a fresh visual presentation.
  • A web search tool driven by AI.
  • A health-specific AI agent integrated into the forthcoming Health+ subscription service.

These innovations aim to enhance Apple Intelligence, which first launched with iOS 18 and has been evolving through continued updates. Notably, an expansive revision of Siri is anticipated with iOS 26.4, targeted for release by March or April 2026, in advance of iOS 27’s debut at WWDC 2026.

Siri Revamp to Include Visual Interactivity

The updated Siri in iOS 27 is likely to feature a visual redesign intended to imbue it with a more dynamic personality. Earlier hints from Gurman suggest Apple is experimenting with making Siri look more lifelike, possibly drawing inspiration from the Finder icon. This change aims to make the interaction with Siri seem more lively and less like conversing with a static voice assistant.

This visual overhaul builds on planned performance enhancements in iOS 26.4 aimed at refining Siri’s ability to execute on-device tasks leveraging Apple Intelligence. The two-step approach of improving functionality followed by updating appearance may ease user transition and set realistic expectations.

Potential Challenge to Google with AI-Powered Web Search

Another highlight is Apple’s work on an AI-powered web search tool. Though specifics are sparse, this move could help Apple lessen its reliance on major search engines like Google. Harnessing Apple Intelligence, the tool may present summarized outcomes, highlight essential facts, or deliver straightforward answers, offering users a more cohesive search experience directly within Safari or Siri.

If executed, this tool could position Apple against rising AI-enhanced search solutions from entities like OpenAI and Perplexity, which blend traditional search outputs with conversational summaries.

AI Health Agent Could Transform Health+ Service

The third notable feature involves integrating a new AI agent into Apple’s Health app through a subscription service labeled Health+. According to Gurman, this agent would assist users in monitoring health metrics, recommending lifestyle improvements, and furnishing wellness advice tailored to their personal data.

This addition underscores Apple’s ambition in health-focused AI. Earlier in the year, Apple’s Fitness+ unit was realigned under its Health team, foreshadowing efforts to streamline its wellness services. Success for Health+ could make Apple a frontrunner in establishing a foothold within the AI health assistant market.

A Promising Future for Apple Intelligence

Though iOS 26 will usher in crucial upgrades to Siri, the advancements expected in iOS 27 seem to represent a significant evolution for Apple Intelligence. By reshaping Siri, enhancing search capabilities, and introducing a personalized health advisor, Apple appears to be fortifying a smart, interconnected ecosystem across its devices.

The insights reported were initially shared by Mark Gurman in Bloomberg’s Power On newsletter and have been encapsulated by 9to5Mac.

Do these potential new features catch your interest? Share your thoughts below.

excerpt.rendered: Apple’s iOS 27 could introduce an upgraded Siri, AI-powered web search, and a Health+ wellness agent, shaping the next phase of Apple Intelligence.

title.rendered: AI-Powered Apple Health+ Service Could Launch in 2026

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple Health+ targets AI-powered wellness in 2026 with a virtual health assistant offering personalized advice, nutrition tracking, and video-based health guidance.
  • Fitness+ merges into Health to streamline AI coaching as Apple restructures services under one health-focused platform ahead of its AI push.
  • Apple aims to rival Whoop and Oura by delivering deeper, actionable insights—avoiding the superficial AI feedback common in current health wearables.
  • Apple Watch and Siri integration could amplify impact by combining real-time data with conversational AI and redesigned Siri tools in iOS 27.
  • Privacy, accuracy, and medical limits remain key concerns as Apple ventures into AI wellness—Health+ isn’t a substitute for professional diagnosis or urgent care.

Apple’s foray into AI health assistance may intensify with a new Health+ service slated for 2026, as reported by Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. This service is expected to significantly revamp the Health app, positioning Apple as a contender in the AI-driven wellness sector.

Apple Health+ Will Include an AI Health Assistant

Gurman outlined in his Power On newsletter plans for Apple to roll out Health+ alongside comprehensive changes to the Health app next year. The service is anticipated to feature an AI chatbot designed to provide personalized health advice, track nutrition, and offer expert health guidance via video. This virtual assistant’s goal is to aid users in monitoring their wellbeing and fostering healthier lifestyles through customized insights.

This development aligns with Apple’s ongoing expansion into health and fitness arenas. Earlier in the year, the company consolidated Apple Fitness+ under its Health arm following COO Jeff Williams’ exit. This shift hints at Apple’s strategy to integrate its health services, merging Fitness+ with the forthcoming Health+ for a streamlined user experience.

Fitness+ Integration Could Boost Apple’s AI Health Plans

A report from AppleInsider indicated that moving Fitness+ to the Health division dovetails with Apple’s AI ambitions for 2026. The Health+ subscription might serve as a hub, merging health data, AI-based coaching, and exercise programs into a unified platform. Apple appears to see a chance to rejuvenate its lagging Fitness+ offering by raising its profile and linking it with AI-enhanced health options.

Competing With AI Health Platforms Like Whoop and Oura

Apple’s upcoming health chatbot will face off against AI-driven health platforms such as Whoop and Oura. These competitors already provide AI insights on sleep, fitness, and recovery, though have been criticized for offering superficial AI feedback. The challenge for Apple will be to ensure Health+ delivers substantive, actionable insights rather than generic overviews.

Executed effectively, Apple could emerge as a leading tech company in AI-enabled health guidance. Its existing ecosystem, encompassing the Apple Watch, Health app, and Fitness+, offers an edge in gathering real-time health data to furnish personalized suggestions.

Siri Redesign and Apple Intelligence Expansion in 2026

Gurman further mentioned that Apple’s expanded AI plans include a redesigned Siri for iOS 27 and an AI-supported web search tool anticipated with iOS 26.4. These enhancements, alongside Health+, are steps in Apple’s wider strategy to integrate Apple Intelligence throughout its devices and services.

Should the reports prove accurate, the Health+ service could signal one of Apple’s most significant moves in personalized AI wellness. Coupling the strengths of Fitness+, Siri, and Apple Intelligence, 2026 could become a banner year for the company’s ventures into health tech.

Would a service like this make an impact on your daily routine? Share your thoughts below.

title.rendered: iPhone Depth Effect Greyed Out? Try These Simple Fixes

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Why the Depth Effect fails: The Depth Effect uses on-device machine learning to place the clock behind your wallpaper subject, but it can fail due to low contrast, poor subject placement, or an unsupported image.
  • Device compatibility: The feature works on iPhones with A12 Bionic or newer, including iPhone XR, iPhone SE (2nd/3rd gen), and later models.
  • Enable the Depth Effect: Make sure the Depth Effect toggle is turned on under Lock Screen customization, and preview changes directly from the Lock Screen.
  • Remove interfering widgets: Lock Screen widgets can block the effect, so remove them temporarily to check if the Depth Effect returns.
  • Choose the right wallpaper: Pick a sharp, well-lit photo where the main subject overlaps the clock area, and reposition it slightly to trigger the effect.

The Depth Effect on the iPhone Lock Screen adds a subtle 3D touch that makes your wallpaper pop. But sometimes, the option is greyed out or the subject doesn’t layer properly when setting your wallpaper. If the Depth Effect isn’t working on your iPhone, here’s why it happens and how to fix it.

Table of Contents
  • Why Is the Depth Effect Not Working?
  • How to Fix Depth Effect Wallpaper Not Working on iPhone
    • 1. Check if Your iPhone Supports Depth Effect
    • 2. Make Sure Depth Effect Is Enabled
    • 3. Remove Lock Screen Widgets
    • 4. Use a Supported Wallpaper
    • 5. Reposition the Wallpaper
    • 6. Create a New Lock Screen
    • 7. Hard Reset Your iPhone
  • Wrapping Up

Why Is the Depth Effect Not Working?

The Depth Effect places the clock behind the main subject of your wallpaper. Apple uses on-device machine learning to detect the subject and create a layered look, making it appear as if the time sits between the subject and the background.

While it usually works seamlessly, the feature can fail to activate for several reasons:

  • Incompatible image: The Depth Effect only works with photos that have a clear subject in the foreground, such as portraits or images with one main focus.
  • Subject placement: The subject should be near the center and reach into the clock area. If it’s too far off to the side or too small, the effect won’t apply.
  • Low lighting or poor contrast: Dark or blurry images make it hard for the iPhone to separate the subject from the background.
  • Outdated iOS version: Your device must be running a recent iOS version that supports Depth Effect wallpapers.
  • Disabled setting: The Depth Effect toggle may be turned off while setting your wallpaper.

Now that you know what might be causing the issue, let’s go through the fixes.

How to Fix Depth Effect Wallpaper Not Working on iPhone

Here are seven reliable ways to restore the Depth Effect on your iPhone Lock Screen.

1. Check if Your iPhone Supports Depth Effect

The feature works on iPhones powered by the A12 Bionic chip or newer, including iPhone XR and later, as well as the iPhone SE (2nd and 3rd generation).

If your iPhone is compatible but the effect still doesn’t show up, move on to the next steps.

2. Make Sure Depth Effect Is Enabled

The Depth Effect is on by default, but it’s best to double-check.

  1. Unlock your iPhone using Touch ID or Face ID and stay on the Lock Screen.
  2. Tap and hold an empty space on the Lock Screen.    
  3. Tap Customize and select Lock Screen.
  4. Now, tap the layer icon in the bottom left corner. For custom wallpapers, tap the three-dot icon. 
  5. Check if the Depth Effect On has a tick mark next to it.

3. Remove Lock Screen Widgets

Widgets can block the Depth Effect. If you’ve added any to your Lock Screen, remove them and see if the effect returns.

  1. Go to the wallpaper customizing screen using the steps above.  
  2. Now, tap a widget in your widget area.
  3. Select the (–) sign beside each widget to remove it.

4. Use a Supported Wallpaper

The Depth Effect only works when your photo has a clear, identifiable subject that reaches the clock area. It won’t apply to abstract, minimal, or overly busy images.

Portrait mode photos or Apple’s default wallpapers tend to work best. Make sure your chosen image is bright, sharp, and has enough contrast to highlight the main subject.

Check out: 20+ Stunning Depth Effect Wallpapers for iPhone

5. Reposition the Wallpaper

If your wallpaper isn’t aligned correctly, the Depth Effect may fail to trigger. You can easily reposition it:

  1. Unlock your iPhone and stay on the Lock Screen.  
  2. Tap and hold an empty area and select Lock Screen.
  3. Tap Customize.
  4. Select the wallpaper and then adjust it by pinching it in and out next to the clock area to see if the Depth Effect works.
  5. Now, reposition the wallpaper as required while keeping an eye on the preview.
  6. You can also swipe left to apply different filters and styles.
  7. Tap Done to save the Lock Screen wallpaper.

6. Create a New Lock Screen

If adjustments don’t work, start fresh. Create a new Lock Screen and select a wallpaper that clearly meets all the Depth Effect criteria. This often resets whatever was blocking the feature.

7. Hard Reset Your iPhone

If none of the above fixes work, a force restart might help. It clears temporary glitches that could prevent the feature from activating.

After restarting, try applying different wallpapers. If the Depth Effect still won’t work, consider resetting your iPhone’s settings as a last resort.

Wrapping Up

Hopefully, one of these steps helped you get the Depth Effect back on your iPhone Lock Screen. If not, make sure your iPhone is updated to the latest iOS version, as Apple often includes small fixes for wallpaper features in system updates.

Here are some more interesting reads for you: 

  • iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper disappeared? 7 Fixes
  • How to delete wallpaper on your iPhone
  • How to make your iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper shuffle through photos
  • Best iPhone settings to reduce eye strain

keyPoints.title: Why Is the Depth Effect Not Working?
keyPoints.explanation: The Depth Effect uses machine learning to layer the clock behind the wallpaper subject, but it can fail due to incompatible images, subject placement, poor contrast, outdated iOS, or disabled settings.

keyPoints.title: Check Support for Depth Effect
keyPoints.explanation: The feature works on iPhones with A12 Bionic chips or newer, including iPhone XR and later models, as well as iPhone SE (2nd and 3rd gen).

keyPoints.title: Ensure Depth Effect Is Enabled
keyPoints.explanation: Double-check that the Depth Effect toggle is turned on in the Lock Screen customization options, and that you’re viewing the Lock Screen while making adjustments.

keyPoints.title: Remove Lock Screen Widgets
keyPoints.explanation: Widgets can block the Depth Effect from appearing, so removing any existing widgets from the Lock Screen can help restore the effect.

keyPoints.title: Use a Supported Wallpaper and Reposition it
keyPoints.explanation: Choose a bright, sharp photo with a clear main subject that reaches the clock area, and reposition it carefully to ensure the Depth Effect activates properly.

title.rendered: How to Turn On or Off Stolen Device Protection on iPhone

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • What Is Stolen Device Protection and How It Works: Apple’s iPhone feature that locks sensitive actions behind Face ID or Touch ID, even if someone knows your passcode.
  • Why You Should Turn It On: Stolen Device Protection stops thieves from changing settings, passwords, or banking info without biometric verification, keeping your data safe.
  • What You’ll Need First: Your iPhone must run iOS 17.3 or later with Face ID or Touch ID, Find My, Location Services, and two-factor authentication enabled.
  • How to Enable or Disable It: Go to Settings > Face ID & Passcode, scroll to Stolen Device Protection, then toggle it on or off and choose your security mode.
  • Things to Remember: Disable the feature before selling your iPhone, keep location data current, and note that damaged Face ID or Touch ID sensors can block access.

Keeping your iPhone safe isn’t just about finding it if it goes missing; it’s also about protecting the personal data inside it. To strengthen your privacy and security, Apple introduced Stolen Device Protection, a feature designed to stop thieves from accessing or changing your sensitive information even if they know your passcode.

In this guide, I’ll explain what Stolen Device Protection is, how it works, and how to turn it on or off to keep your iPhone data secure.

Table of Contents
  • What Is Stolen Device Protection and How Does It Work
  • Why You Should Enable Stolen Device Protection on Your iPhone
  • Requirements Before You Can Use It
  • How to Enable or Disable Stolen Device Protection on iPhone
  • Tips and Edge Cases to Keep in Mind
  • Why This Matters in 2025
  • Final Thoughts

What Is Stolen Device Protection and How Does It Work

Stolen Device Protection is Apple’s built-in security layer that protects your most sensitive settings and data if your iPhone is stolen or lost, even if someone already knows your passcode.

When turned on, your iPhone automatically switches to high-security mode whenever it detects that it’s away from familiar locations like your home or workplace.

In this mode, your iPhone:

  • Requires your Face ID or Touch ID to access or modify sensitive data. The passcode alone is not accepted. 
  • Adds a mandatory one-hour Security Delay before allowing high-risk actions, such as changing your Apple ID password or turning off Find My. After the delay, it requires biometric verification again. 
  • Blocks immediate access to your saved passwords, Apple Card virtual numbers, Safari autofill payment info, and certain banking or Apple Cash actions. 
  • Prevents thieves from turning off Lost Mode, Stolen Device Protection, erasing your device, or setting it up as new without biometric authentication. 

When you’re at a familiar location, the feature stays on but runs quietly in the background. You’ll only notice the extra layer of security when you try to perform a protected action in an unfamiliar area.

Why You Should Enable Stolen Device Protection on Your iPhone

Your iPhone isn’t just a piece of hardware; it holds your personal data, passwords, Apple ID, banking info, and more. If it’s stolen, the real loss goes far beyond the device itself.

That’s where Stolen Device Protection comes in. Even if someone learns your passcode, they can’t change key settings or access sensitive information without biometric verification.

If you want to strengthen your iPhone’s defenses even more, you can also check out our guide on how to protect iPhone data from thieves.

Requirements Before You Can Use It

Before turning this feature on, make sure your iPhone meets these requirements:

  • Running at least iOS 17.3 and later.  
  • You have enabled Face ID or Touch ID, and you have a device passcode.  
  • You have enabled Find My on your iPhone.  
  • Two-factor authentication (2FA) is enabled for your Apple ID.  
  • Location Services and Significant Locations must also be enabled.  

How to Enable or Disable Stolen Device Protection on iPhone

  1. Open the Settings app and tap Face ID & Passcode. 
  2. Enter your device passcode when prompted.
  3. Scroll down and tap Stolen Device Protection. 
  4. Toggle on Stolen Device Protection. 
  5. Choose the mode of enforcement: 
    • Away from Familiar Locations: extra security kicks in only when your iPhone is away from home/work.  
    • Always: it applies everywhere, regardless of location.
  6. If you ever want to disable it, go back and toggle it off. However, if it’s set to Always, you might need to wait for the security delay or sign in via iCloud.com to disable.

Tips and Edge Cases to Keep in Mind

  • If your Face ID/Touch ID hardware is damaged (screen replaced, sensor broken), you may not be able to easily turn off Stolen Device Protection, as the feature requires biometric verification.  
  • Before trading in or selling your iPhone, turn off this protection, sign out of your Apple ID, and disable Find My. Otherwise, the next user might face hurdles.  
  • Because this feature uses location awareness, make sure your home/work addresses are set correctly. 
  • Even with this turned on: take regular backups, keep your passcode strong, and don’t share your Apple ID credentials. It’s one layer among many. 

Why This Matters in 2025

Phone theft isn’t as simple as someone snatching your device and selling it. Thieves have grown smarter. According to a Wall Street Journal report, thieves were capturing your passcode entry via long-range cameras, then using it to unlock the phone, turn off tracking, change Apple ID settings, and drain accounts.  

By enforcing biometric checks and delays for critical changes, Apple is raising the bar for how quickly a thief can act. For everyday users, especially those with financial apps, sensitive data, or corporate devices, that extra barrier offers real peace of mind.

Final Thoughts

Stolen Device Protection is one of Apple’s most impactful security features yet. It works quietly in the background, but when it’s needed, it can prevent serious damage.

If you haven’t turned it on yet, do it now. It only takes a minute and won’t affect your everyday iPhone experience.

Do you use any other iPhone security features? Share your setup or favorite tips in the comments below!

Read more:

  • 7 Tips to Secure your iPhone and iPad Lock Screen
  • How to check Activation Lock before buying a used Apple device
  • 12 iPhone security and emergency features you should start using

keyPoints.title: What Is Stolen Device Protection and How Does It Work
keyPoints.explanation: Apple's built-in security layer that protects sensitive information when your iPhone is lost or stolen, even if the passcode is known, by requiring biometric verification for key actions.

keyPoints.title: Why You Should Enable Stolen Device Protection on Your iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: This feature safeguards personal data, passwords, and banking info by preventing unauthorized access to settings and sensitive information, even if someone learns your passcode.

keyPoints.title: Requirements Before You Can Use It
keyPoints.explanation: Your device must run iOS 17.3 or later, have Face ID or Touch ID enabled, Find My activated, two-factor authentication set, and Location Services enabled.

keyPoints.title: How to Enable or Disable Stolen Device Protection on iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: Access the setting through Face ID & Passcode, then toggle the feature on or off, choosing the enforcement mode—either only outside familiar locations or always.

keyPoints.title: Tips and Edge Cases to Keep in Mind
keyPoints.explanation: Be aware of potential issues if biometric hardware is damaged, and remember to disable the feature before selling your device; also, keep your location info accurate for optimal security.

title.rendered: Best Apple Watch Bands to Buy in 2026

content.rendered:
Picking the right watch band for your Apple Watch model can feel intimidating with so many cool styles, colors, and materials to explore. To help you out, I’ve tested multiple Apple Watch bands over the past few weeks and curated a list of the best ones. Along with the list, you’ll also learn how we chose each pick and the factors to consider when buying a new Apple Watch band.

Table of Contents
  • 5 Best Apple Watch Bands in 2026
    • 1. Spigen Athlex Air
    • 2. amBand E1 Rugged Band & Case
    • 3. NOMAD Modern Leather Band
    • 4. Kades Stainless Steel Band
    • 5. Anne Klein Designer Chain Bracelet for Apple Watch
  • Bonus: Official Apple Watch Bands
  • Which Apple Watch Band is Best for 2026
  • How to Pick the Best Apple Watch Band
  • How Do You Know Which Apple Watch Band Fits Your Watch
  • What’s the Usual Cost of the Best Apple Watch Bands
  • How Did We Know These Are the Best Apple Watch Bands
  • Signing Off

5 Best Apple Watch Bands in 2026 

Below are our top picks for the best bands you can get for your Apple Watch in 2026. I have included the following styles: designer, luxury, sporty, and daily wear bands for both men and women.

1. Spigen Athlex Air

If you’re looking for a comfortable, all-day Apple Watch band that can handle both meetings and workouts with ease, check out the Spigen Athlex Air. The premium nylon fabric strap uses an easy hook-and-loop fastener for a snug, adjustable fit (fits wrists ~155–245mm) and supports a wide range of Apple Watch sizes.  

Moreover, the grip on the pull tab lets you adjust the watch quickly on the go and prevents accidental detachment. The blend of sporty style and soft feel makes it a versatile pick. Just keep in mind that fabric straps may need occasional cleaning, especially after rough use.  

For users needing more band elasticity and breathability, go for the Spigen Lite Fit. 

Compatibility: Apple Watch Ultra 3/2/Ultra 49mm, Series 11/10 46mm, Series 9/8/7 45mm, SE3/SE2/SE/6/5/4 44mm, Series 3/2/1 42mm. 

2. amBand E1 Rugged Band & Case

Want some serious protection for your Apple Watch? The amBand rugged case and strap combo has you covered. It wraps the watch body with raised bumper edges built to absorb impacts and guard against drops and scratches. However, note that it doesn’t include a screen protector. 

Made from soft TPU, the strap is lightweight and flexible, with ventilated channels to keep your wrist comfortable throughout the day. Overall, it’s a strong pick for anyone who wears their watch in rough environments or wants one strap that does it all. Just keep in mind that it’s bulkier than standard bands.  

Compatibility: Provides options specific to 38mm/40mm/41mm, 42mm – Series 11/ 10, 42mm/44mm/45mm, 46mm – Series 11/10, 49mm – Ultra 3/Ultra 2/Ultra

3. NOMAD Modern Leather Band

Leather bands elevate your Apple Watch with style, personality, and quality. NOMAD has used full-grain, sustainably sourced leather that develops a rich patina over time. Additionally, you get a classic buckle built with marine-grade 316 stainless steel. So, the connection to your watch feels solid.  

The buckle also has a PVD treatment for longevity. Designed to fit wrists measuring approximately 150-210 mm, the band is compatible with all Apple Watch models. Therefore, if you want a premium, stylish band that works day-to-day and ages with character, this is a solid pick.

Compatibility: Apple Watch models (49 mm/45 mm/44 mm/42 mm), including Ultra 1-3, Series 1-11, and SE.  

4. Kades Stainless Steel Band

Metal Apple Watch bands remain a popular option for professionals, especially men. Kades Stainless Steel Band is crafted from high-quality, waterproof 316 stainless steel for a sleek, durable look. It offers a premium finish with matte-polished links and a secure double-buckle butterfly buckle.   

The best part is its easy-link removal design, which lets you fine-tune the fit. The link remover pin is included in the box. Moreover, if your wrist exceeds 230mm, the brand offers 10 extra links so you can wear it comfortably. However, it’s heavier than sport bands, so it may feel more substantial on the wrist. 

Compatibility: Apple Watch Ultra 3/Ultra 2/Ultra 49mm, iWatch Series 11/10 46mm, Series 9/8/7 45mm, Series 6/5/4/SE3/SE2/SE 44mm, Series 3/2/1 42mm. 

5. Anne Klein Designer Chain Bracelet for Apple Watch

If you’re looking to turn your Apple Watch into a more luxurious fashion statement, the Anne Klein Fashion Chain Bracelet band is a stylish pick for women. With its designer-chain link construction and beautiful gold finish, it complements your style.  

I liked its high-end crystal-accented charms hanging from the band. Offering the best fit and comfort, it has three detachable links for adjustment.  In addition, the clasp closing on the jewelry is easy to use and safe.     

Compatibility: Apple Watch models with 42mm & 44/45/46/49mm

Bonus: Official Apple Watch Bands

If your budget permits, the official Apple Watch bands are no match for them. Their compatibility, material, and finish are trusted. You’ll also get solid support and quality from Apple. 

  • Apple Sport Band: Built from custom fluoroelastomer with a pin‑and‑tuck closure, it’s best for everyday comfort and workouts.  
  • Apple Sport Loop: A softer nylon woven band with a hook-and-loop fastener, great for all-day wear and comfort.  
  • Apple Milanese Loop: It’s a mesh stainless steel band for a refined and premium look.  
  • Apple Solo Loop: A seamless, no-clasp band for ease and minimal style. It also has a braided version of stretchable yarn interwoven with silicone threads. 
  • Apple Magnetic Link: Made using Apple’s innovative FineWoven material for a suede-like feel. The molded magnets wrap snugly around your wrist. 

Along with these options, Apple offers a range of options for brands like Nike and Hermès.

Which Apple Watch Band is Best for 2026

When choosing a band for your Apple Watch, it comes down to use case, style, and build quality. Here’s a quick overview to help you decide which is right for you. 

  • The Spigen Athlex Air and amBand rugged case strap combo is ideal if you’re active, outdoorsy, or want your watch to survive tough usage.  
  • The NOMAD leather band and Anne Klein designer bracelet are perfect if you treat your Apple Watch as a fashion accessory. It’s best when attending events or meetings.  
  • The Kades stainless steel band is great for turning your Apple Watch into a classic wristwatch. It’s better for formal or business wear. 

How to Pick the Best Apple Watch Band

When choosing the best Apple Watch band, there are several factors to keep in mind to ensure you get the right fit, comfort, and style that suits your fancy.

  • Compatibility: Apple Watch bands come in different sizes, so make sure the band you choose is compatible with your watch model. For example, bands for 38mm and 40mm watches are interchangeable, as are bands for 42mm and 44mm watches. Some bands, like Apple’s sports band, come in sizes such as S/M and M/L, so if you are buying one, make sure it is not too big or too small for your wrist.
  • Durability: You would be wasting your hard-earned money if you buy an Apple Watch band that cannot withstand the daily wear and tear it encounters, given your lifestyle. So, it is important to consider materials that last, such as reinforced silicone or leather.
  • Style: Consider where and when you plan to wear your Apple Watch when choosing a band. It wouldn’t be wise to wear a leather band during fitness activities or to don a sports loop for professional meetings.
  • Cost: Another critical factor to consider when choosing an Apple Watch band. Before you start looking for a band, set your budget. The cost of an Apple Watch band mainly depends on the material it is made from. However, third-party options are always more affordable than Apple’s official watch bands.

How Do You Know Which Apple Watch Band Fits Your Watch

Apple Watch bands come in different sizes to accommodate the varying dimensions of Apple Watch models. You can find bands for 38mm, 40mm, 41mm, 42mm, 44mm, 45mm, and 49mm cases, so it’s crucial to know your watch’s size before purchasing a band. Apple Watch bands are generally compatible within their size ranges, so, for example, a band made for a 44mm watch will also fit a 45mm case.

Additionally, the material and design of the band can affect its fit. Some bands, like the Solo Loop, come in specific sizes that need to match your wrist circumference, while others, like the Sport Loop, are adjustable for a more flexible fit.

What’s the Usual Cost of the Best Apple Watch Bands

The cost of an Apple Watch band can vary greatly depending on the material, style, and comfort it offers. The affordable options usually start at $30, while the premium ones can reach hundreds of dollars, depending on whether they are made from silicone, nylon, leather, or stainless steel.

While official Apple Watch bands are almost always pricy, you can easily find affordable and quality watch bands from third-party brands at a fraction of Apple’s price.

How Did We Know These Are the Best Apple Watch Bands

Our selection of the best Apple Watch is based on my and my team’s personal experience, the brand’s reputation, user reviews, and extensive testing I’ve been doing for the past few weeks. The team and I have personally tested each band on this list for the style, comfort, durability, and functionality it can offer.

Additionally, customer feedback and expert reviews were also taken into account to ensure that each Apple Watch band meets the demands of a broader range of users. Whether you are a fitness enthusiast or a business professional often busy in meetings, there is an Apple Watch band on this list for you.

Signing Off

That’s pretty much it. Choosing the right Apple Watch band is another way to express your style while ensuring it feels comfortable and serves its purpose well. Before making a buying decision, consider all the key factors outlined in this post and choose the one that suits your lifestyle, giving your Apple Watch a brand-new look.

Got some doubts? Feel free to reach out to us via comments.
